<s>Svapnavāsavadattam</s> (The Dream of <s>Vāsavadattā</s>)
  {After the benediction, the Stage Manager (<s>sūtradhāra</s>) enters.}
*{Stage Manager}* —

body.text: udayanavendusavarṇāvāsavadattābalau balasya tvām &

children.text: padmāvatīrṇapūrṇau vasantakamrau bhujau pātām // BhSv_1.1 //
children.translated_text: and adorned by <s>Padmāvatī</s>, beautiful as springtime, protect you! // BhSv_1.1 //

body.translated_text: May the arms of King <s>Udayana</s>, equal in complexion to the moon, embracing <s>Vāsavadattā</s> with the strength of <s>Bala</s> [<s>Indra</s>],

body.text:
evam āryamiśrān vijñāpayāmi (BhSv_1.1:1)
aye kin nu khalu mayi vijñāpanavyagre śabda iva śrūyate (BhSv_1.1:2)
aṅga paśyāmi (BhSv_1.1:3)
  {nepathye} ussaraha ussaraha ayyā ussaraha (BhSv_1.1:4)
[utsaratotsaratāryāḥ utsarata | ]
body.translated_text:
Thus I inform the honorable assembly. But what is this? While I am engaged in making this announcement, a noise seems to be heard. Let me see.
  {From backstage:} 'Make way! Make way, noble ones! Make way!'
[Make way! Make way, noble ones! Make way!]

body.text: *{sūtradhāraḥ}* - bhavatu vijñātam (BhSv_1.1:5)
body.translated_text: *{Stage Manager}* — Very well, I understand.

body.text: bhṛtyair magadharājasya snigdhaiḥ kanyānugāmibhiḥ &

children.text: dhṛṣṭham utsāryate sarvas tapovanagato janaḥ // BhSv_1.2 //
children.translated_text: all the people in the hermitage grove are being rudely driven away. // BhSv_1.2 //

body.translated_text: By the loyal servants of the king of <s>Magadha</s>, who accompany his daughter,

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati parivrājakaveṣo yaugandharāyaṇa āvantikāveṣadhāriṇī vāsavadattā ca (BhSv_1.2:3)}
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* -
  {karṇaṃ dattvā} katham ihāpy utsāryate (BhSv_1.2:4)
kutaḥ
body.translated_text:
{Then enter <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> in the guise of a wandering ascetic, and <s>Vāsavadattā</s> wearing the dress of a woman from <s>Avantī</s>.}
*{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* —
  {Listening:} What, they are driving people away here too?
How so —

body.text: dhīrasyāśramasaṃśritasya vasatas tuṣṭasya vanyaiḥ phalair mānārhasya janasya valkalavatas trāsaḥ samutpādyate &

children.text: utsikto vinayād apetapuruṣo bhāgyaiś calair vismitaḥ ko 'yaṃ bho nibhṛtaṃ tapovanam idaṃ grāmīkaroty ājñayā // BhSv_1.3 //
children.translated_text: Puffed up, devoid of courtesy, astonished by fickle fortune — who is this fellow who, by his command, is turning this peaceful hermitage into a village? // BhSv_1.3 //

body.translated_text: A steady man, dwelling in a hermitage, content with forest fruits, worthy of respect, wearing bark garments — fear is being caused to such a person!

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ayya ko eso ussāredi (BhSv_1.3:1)
[ārya ka eṣa utsārayati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Noble sir, who is this driving [people] away?
[Noble sir, who is this driving [people] away?]

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - bhavati yo dharmād ātmānam utsārayati (BhSv_1.3:2)
*{vāsavadattā}* - ayya ṇa hi evvaṃ vattukāmā ahaṃ vi ṇāma ussāraidavvā homi tti (BhSv_1.3:3)
[ārya na hy evaṃ vaktukāmā aham api nāmotsārayitavyā bhavāmīti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Lady, one who drives himself away from <s>dharma</s>.
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Noble sir, that is not what I meant to say — am I too to be driven away?
[Noble sir, that is not what I meant to say — am I too to be driven away?]

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - bhavati evam anirjñātāni daivatāny avadhūyante (BhSv_1.3:4)
*{vāsavadattā}* - ayya taha parissamo parikhedaṃ ṇa uppādedi jaha aaṃ paribhavo (BhSv_1.3:5)
[ārya tathā pariśramaḥ parikhedaṃ notpādayati yathāyaṃ paribhavaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Lady, thus are unrecognized divinities treated with contempt.
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Noble sir, weariness does not produce such distress as this humiliation does.
[Noble sir, weariness does not produce such distress as this humiliation does.]

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - bhuktojjhita eṣa viṣayo 'trabhavatyā (BhSv_1.3:6)
nātra cintā kāryā (BhSv_1.3:7)
kutaḥ
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — This realm has been enjoyed and abandoned by Your Ladyship. No worry should be made here. How so —

body.text: pūrvaṃ tvayāpy abhimataṃ gatam evam āsīc chlāghyaṃ gamiṣyasi punar vijayena bhartuḥ &

children.text: kālakrameṇa jagataḥ parivartamānā cakrārapaṅktir iva gacchati bhāgyapaṅktiḥ // BhSv_1.4 //
children.translated_text: With the turning of time, the world revolves — the row of fortunes goes like a row of [water-wheel] spokes. // BhSv_1.4 //

body.translated_text: You too have experienced such [glory] in the past; you shall again enjoy it gloriously through your husband's victory.

body.text:
*{bhaṭau}* - ussaraha ayyā ussaraha (BhSv_1.4:1)
[utsaratāryāḥ utsarata | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Two soldiers}* — Make way, noble ones! Make way!
[Make way, noble ones! Make way!]

{Then enters the chamberlain (<s>kāñcukīya</s>).}
*{Chamberlain}* — Fellow, no, no — they should not be driven away! Look —

body.text: pariharatu bhavān nṛpāpavādaṃ na paruṣam āśramavāsiṣu prayojyam &

children.text: nagaraparibhavān vimoktum ete vanam abhigamya manasvino vasanti // BhSv_1.5 //
children.translated_text: To escape the humiliations of city life, these noble-minded ones have come to dwell in the forest. // BhSv_1.5 //

body.translated_text: Let the lord avoid reproach among kings — harshness should not be used against hermitage-dwellers.

body.text:
*{ubhau}* - ayya taha (BhSv_1.5:1)
[ārya tathā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Both}* — Yes, sir.
[Yes, sir.]

body.text:
{niṣkrāntau (BhSv_1.5:2)}
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - hanta savijñānam asya darśanam (BhSv_1.5:3)
vatse upasarpāvas tāvad enam (BhSv_1.5:4)
*{vāsavadattā}* - ayya taha (BhSv_1.5:5)
[ārya tathā | ]
body.translated_text:
{They exit.}
*{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Ah, this one's appearance shows discernment. Child, let us approach him.
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Yes, sir.
[Yes, sir.]

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* -
  {upasṛtya} bhoḥ kiṅkṛteyam utsāraṇā (BhSv_1.5:6)
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhos tapasvin (BhSv_1.5:7)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* -
  {ātmagatam} tapasvinn iti guṇavān khalv ayam ālāpaḥ (BhSv_1.5:8)
aparicayāt tu na śliṣyate me manasi (BhSv_1.5:9)
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhoḥ śrūyatām (BhSv_1.5:10)
eṣā khalu gurubhir abhihitanāmadheyasyāsmākaṃ mahārājadarśakasya bhaginī padmāvatī nāma (BhSv_1.5:11)
saiṣā no mahārājamātaraṃ mahādevīm āśramasthām abhigamyānujñātā tatrabhavatyā rājagṛham eva yāsyati (BhSv_1.5:12)
tad adyāsminn āśramapade vāso 'bhipreto 'syāḥ (BhSv_1.5:13)
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* —
  {Approaching:} Sir, what is the reason for this driving away?
*{Chamberlain}* — Ho, ascetic!
*{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* —
  {Aside:} 'Ascetic' — indeed, this is a fine address. But since we are unacquainted, it does not sit well in my mind.
*{Chamberlain}* — Sir, please listen. This is the sister — named <s>Padmāvatī</s> — of our great king, whose name has been spoken by elders, [the king] <s>Darśaka</s> [of <s>Magadha</s>]. She has visited the queen-mother, the chief queen residing in the hermitage, and having received her permission, she will return to <s>Rājagṛha</s>. For today, she wishes to stay at this hermitage.

body.text: tad bhavantaḥ
body.translated_text: Therefore, gentlemen —

body.text: tīrthodakāni samidhaḥ kusumāni darbhān svairaṃ vanād upanayantu tapodhanāni &

children.text: dharmapriyā nṛpasutā na hi dharmapīḍām icchet tapasviṣu kulavratam etad asyāḥ // BhSv_1.6 //
children.translated_text: This princess is devoted to <s>dharma</s> and would not wish to cause distress to ascetics in matters of <s>dharma</s> — this is the vow of her family. // BhSv_1.6 //

body.translated_text: Let the ascetics freely bring from the forest holy water, firewood, flowers, and sacred grass.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* -
  {svagatam} evam (BhSv_1.6:1)
eṣā sā magadharājaputrī padmāvatī nāma yā puṣpakabhadrādibhir ādeśikair ādiṣṭā svāmino devī bhaviṣyatīti (BhSv_1.6:2)
tataḥ
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* —
  {Aside:} So it is! This is that princess of the king of <s>Magadha</s>, named <s>Padmāvatī</s>, whom the astrologers <s>Puṣpakabhadra</s> and others have predicted will become my master's queen. Therefore —

body.text: pradveṣo bahumāno vā saṅkalpād upajāyate &

children.text: bhartṛdārābhilāṣitvād asyāṃ me mahatī svatā // BhSv_1.7 //
children.translated_text: Because I desire her as a wife for my master, I feel great affection toward her. // BhSv_1.7 //

body.translated_text: Hatred or esteem arises from imagination.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {svagatam} rāadāria tti suṇia bhaiṇiāsiṇeho vi me ettha sampajjai (BhSv_1.7:1)
[rājadāriketi śrutvā bhaginikāsneho 'pi me 'tra saṃpadyate | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} Hearing [the word] 'princess,' a sisterly affection arises in me toward her.
[Hearing 'princess,' a sisterly affection arises in me toward her.]

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati padmāvatī saparivārā ceṭī ca (BhSv_1.7:2)}
*{ceṭī}* - edu edu bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_1.7:3)
idaṃ assamapadaṃ pavisadu (BhSv_1.7:4)
[etv etu bhartṛdārikā idam āśramapadaṃ praviśatu | ]

*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {svagatam} iaṃ sā rāadāriā (BhSv_1.7:7)
abhijaṇāṇurūvaṃ khu se rūvaṃ (BhSv_1.7:8)
[iyaṃ sā rājadārikā | abhijanānurūpaṃ khalv asyā rūpam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} This is that princess. Indeed, her beauty befits her noble birth.
[This is that princess. Indeed, her beauty befits her noble birth.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye vandāmi (BhSv_1.7:9)
[ārye vande | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble lady, I salute you.
[Noble lady, I salute you.]

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - ciraṃ jīva (BhSv_1.7:10)
pavisa jāde pavisa (BhSv_1.7:11)
tavovaṇāṇi ṇāma adihijaṇassa saagehaṃ (BhSv_1.7:12)
[ciraṃ jīva | praviśa jāte praviśa | tapovanāni nāmātithijanasya svageham | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Female ascetic}* — Long may you live! Enter, child, enter. Hermitages are the very home of guests.
[Long may you live! Enter, child, enter. Hermitages are the very home of guests.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - bhodu bhodu (BhSv_1.7:13)
ayye vissatthahmi (BhSv_1.7:14)
imiṇā bahumāṇavaaṇeṇa aṇuggahida hmi (BhSv_1.7:15)
[bhavatu bhavatu | ārye viśvastāsmi | anena bahumānavacanenānugṛhītāsmi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Very well, very well. Noble lady, I feel at ease. I am honored by these words of respect.
[Very well, very well. Noble lady, I feel at ease. I am honored by these words of respect.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {svagatam} ṇa hi rūvaṃ evva vāā vi khu se mahurā (BhSv_1.7:16)
[na hi rūpam eva vāg api khalv asyā madhurā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} Not only her beauty — her speech too is sweet.
[Not only her beauty — her speech too is sweet.]

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - bhadde imaṃ dāva bhaddamuhassa bhaiṇiaṃ kocci rāā ṇa varedi (BhSv_1.7:17)
[bhadre imāṃ tāvad bhadramukhasya bhaginikāṃ kaścid rājā na varayati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Female ascetic}* — Dear one, does no king seek to marry this sister of the handsome-faced one?
[Dear one, does no king seek to marry this sister of the handsome-faced one?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - atthi rāā pajjodo ṇāma ujjaiṇīe (BhSv_1.7:18)
so dāraassa kāraṇādo dūdasampādaṃ karedi (BhSv_1.7:19)
[asti rājā pradyoto nāmojjayinyāḥ | sa dārakasya kāraṇād dūtasampātaṃ karoti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maidservant}* — There is a king named <s>Pradyota</s> of <s>Ujjayinī</s>. He is sending messengers on account of [his] son.
[There is a king named <s>Pradyota</s> of <s>Ujjayinī</s>. He is sending messengers on account of [his] son.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} bhodu bhodu (BhSv_1.7:20)
esā a attaṇīā dāṇiṃ saṃvuttā (BhSv_1.7:21)
[bhavatu bhavatu | eṣā cātmīyedānīṃ saṃvṛttā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} Very well, very well! She has now become one of our own.
[Very well, very well! She has now become one of our own.]

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - arhā khu iaṃ āidī imassa bahumāṇassa (BhSv_1.7:22)
ubhaāṇi rāauḷāṇi mahattarāṇi tti suṇīadi (BhSv_1.7:23)
[arhā khalv iyam ākṛtir asya bahumānasya | ubhe rājakule mahattare iti śrūyate | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Female ascetic}* — Indeed, this appearance is worthy of such honor. Both royal families are great, so it is heard.
[Indeed, this appearance is worthy of such honor. Both royal families are great, so it is heard.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayya kiṃ diṭṭho muṇijaṇo attāṇaṃ aṇuggahīduṃ (BhSv_1.7:24)
abhippedappadāṇeṇa tavassijaṇo uvaṇimantīadu dāva ko kiṃ ettha icchadi tti (BhSv_1.7:25)
[ārya kiṃ dṛṣṭo munijana ātmānam anugrahītum | abhipretapradānena tapasvijana upanimantryatāṃ tāvat kaḥ kim atrecchatīti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble sir, has a group of ascetics been consulted to bestow favor upon themselves? Let the ascetics be invited by offering what they desire — 'Who wants what here?'
[Noble sir, has a group of ascetics been consulted to bestow favor upon themselves? Let the ascetics be invited by offering what they desire — 'Who wants what here?']

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - yad abhipretaṃ bhavatyā (BhSv_1.7:26)
bho bho āśramavāsinas tapasvinaḥ (BhSv_1.7:27)
śṛṇvantu śṛṇvantu bhavantaḥ (BhSv_1.7:28)
ihātrabhavatī magadharājaputrī anena visrambheṇotpāditavisrambhā dharmārtham arthenopanimantrayate (BhSv_1.7:29)
body.translated_text: The <s>Kāñcukīya</s> (chamberlain) — As your ladyship desires. Ho there, ho there, ascetics dwelling in the hermitage! Listen, listen, good sirs! Here, the princess of <s>Magadha</s>, having been put at ease by this confidence, invites with wealth for the sake of <s>dharma</s> (righteousness).

body.text: kasyārthaḥ kalaśena ko mṛgayate vāso yathāniścitaṃ dīkṣāṃ pāritavān kim icchati punar deyaṃ guror yad bhavet &

children.text: ātmānugraham icchatīha nṛpajā dharmābhirāmapriyā yad yasyāsti samīpsitaṃ vadatu tat kasyādya kiṃ dīyatām // BhSv_1.8 //
children.translated_text: The princess, devoted to <s>dharma</s> and dear to the virtuous, desires to bestow a favor here — let whoever has a wish speak it; to whom shall what be given today?

body.translated_text: Who needs wealth? Who seeks a water-pot? Who desires garments as prescribed? Who has completed a religious initiation and wishes again for what should be given to a teacher?

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - hanta dṛṣṭa upāyaḥ (BhSv_1.8:1)
  {prakāśam} bhoḥ aham arthī (BhSv_1.8:2)
*{padmāvatī}* - diṭṭhiā sahaḷaṃ me tavovaṇābhigamaṇaṃ (BhSv_1.8:3)
[diṣṭyā saphalaṃ me tapovanābhigamanam | ]
body.translated_text: <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> — Ah, I have found a stratagem! (Aloud) Sir, I am a supplicant. <s>Padmāvatī</s> — By good fortune, my visit to the hermitage has borne fruit!

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - saṃtuṭṭhatapassijaṇaṃ idaṃ assamapadaṃ (BhSv_1.8:4)
āantueṇa imiṇā hodavvaṃ (BhSv_1.8:5)
[santuṣṭatapasvijanam idam āśramapadam | āgantukenānena bhavitavyam | ]
body.translated_text: The <s>Tāpasī</s> (female ascetic) — This hermitage is home to ascetics who are content. This must be a visitor. [Sanskrit: The people of this hermitage are contented ascetics. This person must be a newcomer.]

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhoḥ kiṃ kriyatām (BhSv_1.8:6)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - iyaṃ me svasā (BhSv_1.8:7)
proṣitabhartṛkām imām icchāmy atrabhavatyā kaṅcit kālaṃ paripālyamānām (BhSv_1.8:8)
kutaḥ
body.translated_text: The <s>Kāñcukīya</s> — Sir, what is to be done? <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> — This is my sister. Her husband is away; I wish her to be looked after by your ladyship for some time. For what reason?

body.text: kāryaṃ naivārthair nāpi bhogair na vastrair nāhaṃ kāṣāyaṃ vṛttihetoḥ prapannaḥ &

children.text: dhīrā kanyeyaṃ dṛṣṭadharmapracārā śaktā cāritraṃ rakṣituṃ me bhaginyāḥ // BhSv_1.9 //
children.translated_text: This maiden is steadfast, well-versed in the ways of <s>dharma</s>, and capable of guarding the conduct of my sister.

body.translated_text: I need nothing — neither wealth, nor pleasures, nor garments; nor have I donned the ochre robes for the sake of livelihood.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} haṃ (BhSv_1.9:1)
iha maṃ ṇikkhividukāmo ayyayogandharāyaṇo (BhSv_1.9:2)
hodu aviāria kamaṃ ṇa karissadi (BhSv_1.9:3)
[ham | iha māṃ nikṣeptukāma āryayaugandharāyaṇaḥ | bhavatu | avicārya kramaṃ na kariṣyati | ]
body.translated_text: <s>Vāsavadattā</s> — (Aside) Alas! The noble <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> wishes to leave me here. So be it — he would not act without deliberation. [Sanskrit: Alas! The noble <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> wishes to deposit me here. So be it — he will not act without proper consideration.]

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhavati mahatī khalv asya vyapāśrayaṇā (BhSv_1.9:4)
kathaṃ pratijānīmaḥ (BhSv_1.9:5)
kutaḥ
body.translated_text: The <s>Kāñcukīya</s> — My lady, this is indeed a great responsibility to undertake. How can we agree to it? For what reason?

body.text: sukham artho bhaved dātuṃ sukhaṃ prāṇāḥ sukhaṃ tapaḥ &

children.text: sukham anyad bhavet sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ nyāsasya rakṣaṇam // BhSv_1.10 //
children.translated_text: Everything else may be easy, but guarding a deposit is difficult.

body.translated_text: It is easy to give wealth, easy to give up one's life, easy to perform austerities,

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayya paḍhamaṃ ugghosia ko kiṃ icchadi tti ajuttaṃ dāṇiṃ viāriduṃ (BhSv_1.10:1)
jaṃ eso bhaṇādi taṃ aṇuciṭṭhadu ayyo (BhSv_1.10:2)
[ārya prathamam udghoṣya kaḥ kim icchatīty ayuktam idānīṃ vicārayitum | yad eṣa bhaṇati tad anutiṣṭhatv āryaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: <s>Padmāvatī</s> — Noble sir, having first proclaimed 'who desires what,' it is improper now to deliberate. Let the noble sir carry out what this man says. [Sanskrit: Noble sir, having first announced 'who desires what,' it is not right now to hesitate. Whatever he says, let the noble sir comply with it.]

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - anurūpam etad bhavatyābhihitam (BhSv_1.10:3)
*{ceṭī}* - ciraṃ jīvadu bhaṭṭidāriā evaṃ saccavādiṇī (BhSv_1.10:4)
[ciraṃ jīvatu bhartṛdārikaivaṃ satyavādinī | ]
body.translated_text: The <s>Kāñcukīya</s> — What your ladyship has said is fitting. The <s>Ceṭī</s> (maidservant) — Long live the young mistress, who speaks so truthfully! [Sanskrit: Long live the young mistress, who is so truthful!]

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - ciraṃ jīvadu bhadde (BhSv_1.10:5)
[ciraṃ jīvatu bhadre | ]
body.translated_text: The <s>Tāpasī</s> — Long live, dear one! [Sanskrit: Long live, good lady!]

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhavati tathā (BhSv_1.10:6)
  {upagamya (BhSv_1.10:7)}
bho abhyupagatam atrabhavato bhaginyāḥ paripālanam atrabhavatyā (BhSv_1.10:8)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - anugṛhīto 'smi tatrabhavatyā (BhSv_1.10:9)
vatse upasarpātrabhavatīm (BhSv_1.10:10)
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} kā gaī (BhSv_1.10:11)
esā gacchāmi mandabhāā (BhSv_1.10:12)
[kā gatiḥ | eṣā gacchāmi mandabhāgā | ]
body.translated_text: The <s>Kāñcukīya</s> — My lady, so be it. (Approaching) Sir, the care of your honor's sister has been accepted by her ladyship. <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> — I am grateful to her ladyship. Child, approach her ladyship. <s>Vāsavadattā</s> — (Aside) What recourse do I have? Here I go, the unfortunate one. [Sanskrit: What recourse is there? Here I go, the ill-fated one.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - bhodu bhodu (BhSv_1.10:13)
attaṇīā dāṇiṃ saṃvuttā (BhSv_1.10:14)
[bhavatu bhavatu | ātmīyedānīṃ saṃvṛttā | ]
body.translated_text: <s>Padmāvatī</s> — Very well, very well! She has now become one of our own. [Sanskrit: Very well, very well! She has now become one of our family.]

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - jā īdisī se āidī iyaṃ vi rāadāria tti takkemi (BhSv_1.10:15)
[yā īdṛśyasyā ākṛtiḥ iyam api rājadāriketi tarkayāmi | ]
body.translated_text: The <s>Tāpasī</s> — Judging by her appearance, I suspect she too is a princess. [Sanskrit: From the look of her, I surmise that she too is a king's daughter.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - suṭṭhu ayyā bhaṇādi (BhSv_1.10:16)
ahaṃ vi aṇuhūdasuhatti pekkhāmi (BhSv_1.10:17)
[suṣṭhu āryā bhaṇati | aham apy anubhūtasukheti paśyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: The <s>Ceṭī</s> — The noble lady speaks well. I too perceive that she has known happiness. [Sanskrit: The noble lady speaks rightly. I too see that she has experienced good fortune.]

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* -
  {ātmagatam} hanta bhoḥ ardham avasitaṃ bhārasya (BhSv_1.10:18)
yathā mantribhiḥ saha samarthitam tathā pariṇamati (BhSv_1.10:19)
tataḥ pratiṣṭhite svāmini tatrabhavatīm upanayato me ihātrabhavatī magadharājaputrī viśvāsasthānaṃ bhaviṣyati (BhSv_1.10:20)

children.text: kutaḥ
children.translated_text: For what reason?

children.text: padmāvatī narapater mahiṣī bhavitrī dṛṣṭā vipattir atha yaiḥ prathamaṃ pradiṣṭā &
children.translated_text: <s>Padmāvatī</s> is destined to become the chief queen of the king; the calamity was foreseen by those who first predicted it.

children.text: tat pratyayāt kṛtam idaṃ na hi siddhavākyāny utkramya gacchati vidhiḥ suparīkṣitāni // BhSv_1.11 //
children.translated_text: Therefore this has been done with confidence, for fate does not deviate from well-tested, proven words.

body.translated_text: <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> — (Aside) Ah, half the burden has been accomplished! Events are unfolding just as was planned with the ministers. When the master is established there, this princess of <s>Magadha</s> will be the ground of trust for me as I present her ladyship to him.

(Then enters a <s>Brahmacārin</s>, a religious student.) The <s>Brahmacārin</s> — (Looking upward) It is midday. I am thoroughly exhausted. Now, in what spot shall I rest? (Walking about) Very well, I see it. There must be a hermitage nearby. For indeed —

body.text: visrabdhaṃ hariṇāś caranty acakitā deśāgatapratyayā vṛkṣāḥ puṣpaphalaiḥ samṛddhaviṭapāḥ sarve dayārakṣitāḥ &

children.text: bhūyiṣṭhaṃ kapilāni gokuladhanāny akṣetravatyo diśo niḥsandigdham idaṃ tapovanam ayaṃ dhūmo hi bahvāśrayaḥ // BhSv_1.12 //
children.translated_text: The cattle herds are mostly tawny, the directions have no tilled fields — without doubt this is a hermitage; and this smoke rises from many dwellings.

body.translated_text: The deer graze at ease, unafraid, confident in the place they have come to know; the trees, with branches laden with flowers and fruits, are all protected by compassion.

body.text:
yāvat praviśāmi (BhSv_1.12:1)
  {praviśya} aye āśramaviruddhaḥ khalv eṣa janaḥ (BhSv_1.12:2)
  {anyato vilokya} athavā tapasvijano 'py atra (BhSv_1.12:3)
nirdoṣam upasarpaṇam (BhSv_1.12:4)
aye strījanaḥ (BhSv_1.12:5)
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - svairaṃ svairaṃ praviśatu bhavān (BhSv_1.12:6)
sarvajanasādhāraṇam āśramapadaṃ nāma (BhSv_1.12:7)
*{vāsavadattā}* - haṃ (BhSv_1.12:8)
*{padmāvatī}* - ammo parapurusadaṃsaṇaṃ pariharadi ayyā (BhSv_1.12:9)
bhodu suparivāḷaṇīo khu maṇṇāso (BhSv_1.12:10)
[ammo parapuruṣadarśanaṃ pariharaty āryā | bhavatu suparipālanīyaḥ khalu mannyāsaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: Let me enter. (Entering) Oh, these people here seem out of place in a hermitage. (Looking another way) Or rather, there are ascetics here too. It is safe to approach. Oh, there are women here! The <s>Kāñcukīya</s> — Enter freely, sir. A hermitage is common to all. <s>Vāsavadattā</s> — Alas! <s>Padmāvatī</s> — Oh, the noble lady shrinks from the sight of a strange man! Very well — the entrusted charge must indeed be well guarded. [Sanskrit: Oh, the noble lady avoids the sight of another man! So be it — the deposit must indeed be carefully guarded.]

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhoḥ pūrvaṃ praviṣṭāḥ smaḥ (BhSv_1.12:11)
pratigṛhyatām atithisatkāraḥ (BhSv_1.12:12)
*{brahmacārī}* -
  {ācamya} bhavatu bhavatu (BhSv_1.12:13)
nivṛttapariśramo 'smi (BhSv_1.12:14)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - bhoḥ kuta āgamyate (BhSv_1.12:15)
kva gantavyam (BhSv_1.12:16)
kvādhiṣṭhānam āryasya (BhSv_1.12:17)
*{brahmacārī}* - bhoḥ śrūyatām (BhSv_1.12:18)
rājagṛhato 'smi (BhSv_1.12:19)
śrutiviśeṣaṇārthaṃ vatsabhūmau lāvāṇakaṃ nāma grāmas tatroṣitavān asmi (BhSv_1.12:20)
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} hā ḷāvāṇaaṃ ṇāma (BhSv_1.12:21)
ḷāvāṇaasaṃkittaṇeṇa puṇo ṇavīkido via me sandāvo (BhSv_1.12:22)
[hā lāvāṇakaṃ nāma | lāvāṇakasaṅkīrtanena punar navīkṛta iva me santāpaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: The <s>Kāñcukīya</s> — Sir, we arrived here first. Please accept our hospitality. The <s>Brahmacārin</s> — (Having sipped water) Very well, very well. My fatigue is gone. <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> — Sir, from where do you come? Where are you going? Where is the noble sir's residence? The <s>Brahmacārin</s> — Sir, please listen. I am from <s>Rājagṛha</s>. For the purpose of special scriptural study, I stayed at a village called <s>Lāvāṇaka</s> in the land of <s>Vatsa</s>. <s>Vāsavadattā</s> — (Aside) Ah, <s>Lāvāṇaka</s>! The very mention of <s>Lāvāṇaka</s> renews my anguish. [Sanskrit: Ah, <s>Lāvāṇaka</s>! By the mention of <s>Lāvāṇaka</s>, my torment is renewed again.]

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - atha parisamāptā vidyā (BhSv_1.12:23)
*{brahmacārī}* - na khalu tāvat (BhSv_1.12:24)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - yady anavasitā vidyā kim āgamanaprayojanam (BhSv_1.12:25)
*{brahmacārī}* - tatra khalv atidāruṇaṃ vyasanaṃ saṃvṛttam (BhSv_1.12:26)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - katham iva (BhSv_1.12:27)
*{brahmacārī}* - tatrodayano nāma rājā prativasati (BhSv_1.12:28)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - śrūyate tatrabhavān udayanaḥ (BhSv_1.12:29)
kiṃ saḥ (BhSv_1.12:30)
*{brahmacārī}* - tasyāvantirājaputrī vāsavadattā nāma patnī dṛḍham abhipretā kila (BhSv_1.12:31)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - bhavitavyam (BhSv_1.12:32)
tatas tataḥ (BhSv_1.12:33)
*{brahmacārī}* - tatas tasmin mṛgayāniṣkrānte rājani grāmadāhena sā dagdhā (BhSv_1.12:34)
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} aḷiaṃ aḷiaṃ khu edaṃ (BhSv_1.12:35)
jīvāmi mandabhāā (BhSv_1.12:36)
[alīkam alīkam khalu etat | jīvāmi mandabhāgā | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Now, have your studies been completed? *{Student}* — Not yet, indeed. *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — If your studies are not finished, what is the purpose of your coming? *{Student}* — A most terrible calamity has occurred there. *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — How so? *{Student}* — There dwells a king named <s>Udayana</s>. *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — The venerable <s>Udayana</s> is known to us. What of him? *{Student}* — His wife, the princess of <s>Avantī</s> named <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, was deeply beloved, they say. *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — That must be so. Then what? *{Student}* — Then, while the king had gone out hunting, she was burned to death in a village fire. *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {aside} False, false is this! I live, ill-fated one that I am.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - tatas tataḥ (BhSv_1.12:37)
*{brahmacārī}* - tatas tām abhyavapattukāmo yaugandharāyaṇo nāma sacivas tasminn evāgnau patitaḥ (BhSv_1.12:38)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - satyaṃ patita iti (BhSv_1.12:39)
tatas tataḥ (BhSv_1.12:40)
*{brahmacārī}* - tataḥ pratinivṛtto rājā tadvṛttāntaṃ śrutvā tayor viyogajanitasantāpas tasminn evāgnau prāṇān parityaktukāmo 'mātyair mahatā yatnena vāritaḥ (BhSv_1.12:41)
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} jāṇāmi jāṇāmi ayyauttassa mai sāṇukkosattaṇaṃ (BhSv_1.12:42)
[jānāmi jānāmy āryaputrasya mayi sānukrośatvam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Then what? *{Student}* — Then, wishing to rescue her, a minister named <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> fell into that very fire. *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Truly, he fell? Then what? *{Student}* — Then the king returned and, hearing the full account, grief-stricken by their separation, wished to give up his life in that very fire, but was prevented with great effort by his ministers. *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {aside} I know, I know the noble prince's compassion toward me.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - tatas tataḥ (BhSv_1.12:43)
*{brahmacārī}* - tatas tasyāḥ śarīropabhuktāni dagdhaśeṣāṇy ābharaṇāni pariṣvajya rājā moham upagataḥ (BhSv_1.12:44)
*{sarve}* - hā (BhSv_1.12:45)
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {svagatam} sakāmo dāṇiṃ ayyajoandharāaṇo hodu (BhSv_1.12:46)
[sakāma idānīm āryayaugandharāyaṇo bhavatu | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Then what? *{Student}* — Then, embracing the ornaments that had adorned her body, the burnt remains, the king fell into a swoon. *{All}* — Alas! *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {aside} May the noble <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> now be satisfied.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie rodidi khu iaṃ ayyā (BhSv_1.12:47)
[bhartṛdārike roditi khalv iyam āryā | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Princess, this noble lady is weeping indeed.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - sāṇukkosāe hodavvaṃ (BhSv_1.12:48)
[sānukrośayā bhavitavyam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — One should be compassionate.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - atha kim atha kim (BhSv_1.12:49)
prakṛtyā sānukrośā me bhaginī (BhSv_1.12:50)
tatas tataḥ (BhSv_1.12:51)
*{brahmacārī}* - tataḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ pratilabdhasaṃjñaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ (BhSv_1.12:52)
*{padmāvatī}* - diṭṭhiā dharai (BhSv_1.12:53)
mohaṃ gado tti suṇia suṇṇaṃ via me hiaam (BhSv_1.12:54)
[diṣṭyā dhriyate | mohaṃ gata iti śrutvā śūnyam iva me hṛdayam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Indeed, indeed! My sister is compassionate by nature. Then what? *{Student}* — Then, gradually, he regained consciousness. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Thank heavens he survives! Hearing that he had fainted, my heart felt as though empty.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - tatas tataḥ (BhSv_1.12:55)
*{brahmacārī}* - tataḥ sa rājā mahītalaparisarpaṇapāṃsupāṭalaśarīraḥ sahasotthāya hā vāsavadatte hā avantirājaputri hā priye hā priyaśiṣye iti kim api bahu pralapitavān (BhSv_1.12:56)
kiṃ bahunā
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Then what? *{Student}* — Then that king, his body reddened with dust from crawling on the ground, suddenly rose up and rambled at great length: 'O <s>Vāsavadattā</s>! O princess of <s>Avantī</s>! O my dear! O my dear pupil!' What more need I say—

body.text: naivedānīṃ tāḍṛśāś cakravākā naivāpy anye strīviśesair viyuktāḥ &

children.text: dhanyā sā strī yāṃ tathā vetti bhartā bhartṛsnehāt sā hi dagdhāpy adagdhā // BhSv_1.13 //
children.translated_text: blessed is that wife whom her husband knows thus—by her husband's love, even though burned, she is unburned.

body.translated_text: No <s>cakravāka</s> birds now are such, nor any others separated from their beloved women;

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - atha bhoḥ taṃ tu paryavasthāpayituṃ na kaścid yatnavān amātyaḥ (BhSv_1.13:1)
*{brahmacārī}* - asti rumaṇvān nāmāmātyo dṛḍhaṃ prayatnavāṃs tatrabhavantaṃ paryavasthāpayitum (BhSv_1.13:2)
sa hi
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — But, sir, was there no minister who exerted himself to console him? *{Student}* — There is a minister named <s>Rumaṇvān</s>, who strives greatly to console the venerable [king]. For he—

body.text: anāhāre tulyaḥ pratataruditakṣāmavadanaḥ śarīre saṃskāraṃ nṛpatisamaduḥkhaṃ parivahan &

children.text: divā vā rātrau vā paricarati yatnair narapatiṃ nṛpaḥ prāṇān sadyas tyajati yadi tasyāpy uparamaḥ // BhSv_1.14 //
children.translated_text: by day or by night, he attends the king with effort; if the king should suddenly give up his life, he too will cease.

body.translated_text: fasting equally [with the king], his face gaunt from constant weeping, bearing upon his body grief equal to the king's,

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} diṭṭhiā suṇikkhitto dāṇīṃ ayyautto (BhSv_1.14:1)
[diṣṭyā sunikṣipta idānīm āryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {aside} Thank heavens the noble prince is now well looked after.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* -
  {ātmagatam} aho mahadbhāram udvahati rumaṇvān (BhSv_1.14:2)
kutaḥ
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — {aside} Ah, <s>Rumaṇvān</s> bears a great burden! For—

body.text: saviśramo hy ayaṃ bhāraḥ prasaktas tasya tu śramaḥ &

children.text: tasmin sarvam adhīnaṃ hi yatrādhīno narādhipaḥ // BhSv_1.15 //
children.translated_text: everything depends on him, for the lord of men depends upon him.

body.translated_text: this burden has respite, but his toil is continuous;

body.text:
{prakāśam} atha bhoḥ paryavasthāpita idānīṃ sa rājā (BhSv_1.15:1)
*{brahmacārī}* - tad idānīṃ na jāne (BhSv_1.15:2)
iha tayā saha hasitam iha tayā saha kathitam iha tayā saha paryuṣitam iha tayā saha kupitam iha tayā saha śayitam ity evaṃ taṃ vilapantaṃ rājānam amātyair mahatā yatnena tasmād grāmād gṛhītvāpakrāntam (BhSv_1.15:3)
tato niṣkrānte rājani proṣitanakṣatracandram iva nabho 'ramaṇīyaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ sa grāmaḥ (BhSv_1.15:4)
tato 'ham api nirgato 'smi (BhSv_1.15:5)
*{tāpasī}* - so khu guṇavanto ṇāma rāā jo āantueṇa vi imiṇā evvaṃ pasaṃsīadi (BhSv_1.15:6)
[sa khalu guṇavān nāma rājā ya āgantukenāpy anenaivaṃ praśasyate | ]
body.translated_text: {aloud} Now, sir, has the king been consoled? *{Student}* — That I do not know now. 'Here I laughed with her, here I talked with her, here I spent the night with her, here I quarreled with her, here I slept with her'—thus lamenting, the king was taken away from that village with great effort by his ministers. After the king departed, the village became unattractive, like the sky without its moon and stars. Then I too departed. *{Ascetic woman}* — He must be a truly virtuous king, since even this stranger praises him so.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie kiṃ ṇu khu avarā itthiā tassa hatthaṃ gamissadi (BhSv_1.15:7)
[bhartṛdārike kin nu khalv aparā strī tasya hastaṃ gamiṣyati | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Princess, will another woman indeed take his hand [in marriage]?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* -
  {ātmagatam} mama hiaeṇa evva saha mantidaṃ (BhSv_1.15:8)
[mama hṛdayenaiva saha mantritam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — {aside} As if counseled by my very own heart!

body.text:
*{brahmacārī}* - āpṛcchāmi bhavantau (BhSv_1.15:9)
gacchāmas tāvat (BhSv_1.15:10)
*{ubhau}* - gamyatām arthasiddhaye (BhSv_1.15:11)
*{brahmacārī}* - tathāstu (BhSv_1.15:12)
  {niṣkrāntaḥ (BhSv_1.15:13)}
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - sādhu aham api tatrabhavatyābhyanujñāto gantum icchāmi (BhSv_1.15:14)
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - tatrabhavatyābhyanujñāto gantum icchati kila (BhSv_1.15:15)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyassa bhaiṇiā ayyeṇa vinā ukkaṇṭhissidi (BhSv_1.15:16)
[āryasya bhaginikāryeṇa vinotkaṇṭhiṣyate | ]
body.translated_text: *{Student}* — I take leave of you both. Let us go now. *{Both}* — Go, for the accomplishment of your purpose. *{Student}* — So be it. {He exits.} *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Very well; I too, with the venerable lady's permission, wish to depart. *{Chamberlain}* — He wishes to depart with the venerable lady's permission, it seems. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — The noble one's sister will be anxious without him.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - sādhujanahastagataiṣā notkaṇṭhiṣyati (BhSv_1.15:17)
  {kāñcukīyam avalokya} gacchāmas tāvat (BhSv_1.15:18)
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - gacchatu bhavān (BhSv_1.15:19)
punardarśanāya (BhSv_1.15:20)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - tathāstu (BhSv_1.15:21)
  {niṣkrāntaḥ (BhSv_1.15:22)}
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - samaya idānīm abhyantaraṃ praveṣṭum (BhSv_1.15:23)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye vandāmi (BhSv_1.15:24)
[ārye vande | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — She is in the hands of good people; she will not be anxious. {Looking at the Chamberlain} Let us go now. *{Chamberlain}* — Go, sir. Until we meet again. *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — So be it. {He exits.} *{Chamberlain}* — It is now time to go inside. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Venerable lady, I pay my respects.

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - jāde tava sadisaṃ bhattāraṃ ḷabhehi (BhSv_1.15:25)
[jāte tava sadṛśaṃ bhartāraṃ labhasva | ]
body.translated_text: *{Ascetic woman}* — My child, may you obtain a husband worthy of you.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ayye vandāmi dāva ahaṃ (BhSv_1.15:26)
[ārye vande tāvad aham | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Venerable lady, I too pay my respects.

body.text:
*{tāpasī}* - tuvaṃ pi aireṇa bhattāraṃ samāsādehi (BhSv_1.15:27)
[tvam apy acireṇa bhartāraṃ samāsādaya | ]
body.translated_text: *{Ascetic woman}* — May you too soon find a husband.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - aṇuggahīda hmi (BhSv_1.15:28)
[anugṛhītāsmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — I am blessed [by your words].

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - tad āgamyatām (BhSv_1.15:29)
ita ito bhavati (BhSv_1.15:30)
samprati hi
body.translated_text: *{Chamberlain}* — Then, let us come. This way, this way, my lady. For now—

body.text: khagā vāsopetāḥ salilam avagāḍho munijanaḥ pradīpto 'gnir bhāti pravicarati dhūmo munivanam &

children.text: paribhraṣṭo dūrād ravir api ca saṃkṣiptakiraṇo rathaṃ vyāvartyāsau praviśati śanair astaśikharam // BhSv_1.16 //
children.translated_text: and the sun, having withdrawn its rays from afar, turning his chariot, slowly enters the western peak.

body.translated_text: the birds have gone to their nests, the sages have entered the water, the kindled fire blazes, smoke wanders through the hermitage grove,

body.text: {niṣkrāntāḥ sarve} prathamo 'ṅkaḥ
body.translated_text: {All exit.} End of Act One.

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati ceṭī (BhSv_2:1)}
*{ceṭī}* - kuñjarie kuñjarie kahiṃ kahiṃ bhaṭṭidāriā padumāvadī (BhSv_2:2)
kiṃ bhaṇāsi esā bhaṭṭidāriā māhavīḷadāmaṇḍavassa passado kandueṇa kīḷaditti (BhSv_2:3)
jāva bhaṭṭidāriaṃ uvasappāmi (BhSv_2:4)
  {parikramya avalokya} ammo iaṃ bhaṭṭidāriā ukkaridakaṇṇacūḷieṇa vāāmasañjādasedabinduviittideṇa parissantaramaṇīadaṃsaṇeṇa muheṇa kandueṇa kīḷandī ido evva āacchadi (BhSv_2:5)
jāva uvasappissaṃ (BhSv_2:6)
[kuñjarike kuñjarike kutra kutra bhartṛdārikā padmāvatī | kiṃ bhaṇasi eṣā bhartṛdārikā mādhavīlatāmaṇḍapasya pārśvataḥ kandukena krīḍatīti | yāvad bhartṛdārikām upasarpāmi | ammo iyaṃ bhartṛdārikā utkṛtakarṇacūlikena vyāyāmasañjātasvedabinduvicitritena pariśrāntaramaṇīyadarśanena mukhena kandukena krīḍantīta evāgacchati | yāvad upasārpsyāmi | ]
body.translated_text:
{Then a maidservant enters.}
*{Maidservant}* — <s>Kuñjarikā</s>! <s>Kuñjarikā</s>! Where, where is the princess <s>Padmāvatī</s>? What do you say — the princess is playing ball beside the <s>mādhavī</s>-creeper pavilion? I shall approach the princess.
  {Walking about and looking:} Oh my! Here comes the princess, playing with a ball, with her face — its hair-ornament pushed aside, speckled with drops of perspiration from exertion, looking even more charming from fatigue — coming this way. I shall approach her.
[<s>Kuñjarikā</s>! <s>Kuñjarikā</s>! Where is the princess <s>Padmāvatī</s>? What do you say — the princess is playing ball beside the <s>mādhavī</s>-creeper pavilion? I shall approach the princess. Oh my! Here comes the princess, playing ball, with her face — its hair-ornament pushed aside, speckled with drops of perspiration from exertion, looking even more charming from fatigue. I shall approach her.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye bhodu dāṇiṃ ettaaṃ (BhSv_2:10)
[ārye bhavatv idānīm etāvat | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble sister, enough for now.
[Noble sister, enough for now.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - haḷā adiciraṃ kandueṇa kīḷia ahiasañjādarāā parakeraā via de hatthā saṃvuttā (BhSv_2:11)
[haḷā aticiraṃ kandukena krīḍitvādhikasañjātarāgau parakīyāv iva te hastau saṃvṛttau | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Dear friend, from playing too long with the ball, your hands have become excessively reddened — as if they belonged to someone else!
[Dear friend, from playing too long with the ball, your hands have become excessively reddened — as if they belonged to someone else!]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - kīḷadu kīḷadu dāva bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_2:12)
ṇivvattīadu dāva aaṃ kaṇṇābhāvaramaṇīo kāḷo (BhSv_2:13)
[krīḍatu krīḍatu tāvad bhartṛdārikā | nirvartyatāṃ tāvad ayaṃ kanyābhāvaramaṇīyaḥ kālaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maidservant}* — Let the princess keep playing! Let this time, made delightful by maidenhood, be enjoyed.
[Let the princess keep playing! Let this time, made delightful by maidenhood, be enjoyed.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye kiṃ dāṇiṃ maṃ ohasiduṃ via ṇijjhāasi (BhSv_2:14)
[ārye kim idānīṃ mām apahasitum iva nidhyāyasi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble sister, why are you gazing at me now as if to mock me?
[Noble sister, why are you gazing at me now as if to mock me?]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ṇahi ṇahi (BhSv_2:15)
haḷā adhiaṃ ajja sohadi (BhSv_2:16)
abhido via de ajja varamukhaṃ pekkhāmi (BhSv_2:17)
[nahi nahi | haḷā adhikam adya śobhate | abhita iva te 'dya varamukhaṃ paśyāmi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — No, no! Dear friend, you look especially radiant today. Today I seem to see your beautiful face as if for the first time.
[No, no! Dear friend, you look especially radiant today. Today I seem to see your beautiful face as if for the first time.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - avehi (BhSv_2:18)
mā dāṇiṃ maṃ ohasa (BhSv_2:19)
[apehi | medānīṃ mām apahasa | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Go away! Don't mock me now.
[Go away! Don't mock me now.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - esahmi tuhṇīā tuhnīā bhavissam mahāseṇavahū (BhSv_2:20)
[eṣāsmi tūṣṇīkā bhaviṣyan mahāsenavadhūḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Here I am, silent — I shall be silent, O bride of <s>Mahāsena</s>!
[Here I am, silent — I shall be silent, O bride of <s>Mahāsena</s>!]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ko eso mahāseṇo ṇāma (BhSv_2:21)
[ka eṣa mahāseno nāma | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Who is this <s>Mahāsena</s>?
[Who is this <s>Mahāsena</s>?]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - atthi ujjaiṇīo rāā pajjodo ṇāma (BhSv_2:22)
tassa baḷa parimāṇaṇivvuttaṃ ṇāmaheaṃ mahāseṇo tti (BhSv_2:23)
[asty ujjayinīyo rājā pradyoto nāma | tasya balaparimāṇanirvṛttaṃ nāmadheyaṃ mahāsena iti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — There is a king of <s>Ujjayinī</s> named <s>Pradyota</s>. His title '<s>Mahāsena</s>' was derived from the magnitude of his army.
[There is a king of <s>Ujjayinī</s> named <s>Pradyota</s>. His title '<s>Mahāsena</s>' was derived from the magnitude of his army.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidāriā teṇa raññā saha sambandhaṃ ṇecchadi (BhSv_2:24)
[bhartṛdārikā tena rājñā saha saṃbandhaṃ necchati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maidservant}* — The princess does not desire an alliance with that king.
[The princess does not desire an alliance with that king.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - aha keṇa khu dāṇiṃ abhiḷasadi (BhSv_2:25)
[atha kena khalv idānīm abhilaṣati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Then whom does she desire now?
[Then whom does she desire now?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - atthi vaccharāo uaaṇo ṇāma (BhSv_2:26)
tassa guṇāṇi bhaṭṭidāriā abhiḷasadi (BhSv_2:27)
[asti vatsarāja udayano nāma | tasya guṇān bhartṛdārikābhilaṣati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maidservant}* — There is a king of <s>Vatsa</s> named <s>Udayana</s>. The princess desires his qualities.
[There is a king of <s>Vatsa</s> named <s>Udayana</s>. The princess desires his qualities.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} ayyauttaṃ bhattāraṃ abhiḷasadi (BhSv_2:28)
  {prakāśam} keṇa kāraṇeṇa (BhSv_2:29)
[āryaputraṃ bhartāram abhilaṣati | kena kāraṇena | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} She desires the noble lord as her husband!
  {Aloud:} For what reason?
[She desires the noble lord as her husband! For what reason?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - sāṇukkoso tti (BhSv_2:30)
[sānukrośa iti | ]
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} jāṇāmi jāṇāmi (BhSv_2:31)
aaṃ vi jaṇo evvaṃ ummādido (BhSv_2:32)
[jānāmi jānāmi | ayam api jana evam unmāditaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maidservant}* — Because he is compassionate.
[Because he is compassionate.]
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} I know, I know! This person too has been enchanted in the same way.
[I know, I know! This person too has been enchanted in the same way.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie jadi so rāā virūvo bhave (BhSv_2:33)
[bhartṛdārike yadi sa rājā virūpo bhavet | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maidservant}* — Princess, what if that king were ugly?
[Princess, what if that king were ugly?]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ṇahi ṇahi (BhSv_2:34)
daṃsaṇīo evva (BhSv_2:35)
[nahi nahi | darśanīya eva | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — No, no! He is indeed handsome.
[No, no! He is indeed handsome.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye kahaṃ tuvaṃ jāṇāsi (BhSv_2:36)
[ārye kathaṃ tvaṃ jānāsi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble sister, how do you know?
[Noble sister, how do you know?]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} ayyauttapakkhavādeṇa adikkando samudāāro (BhSv_2:37)
kiṃ dāṇiṃ karissaṃ (BhSv_2:38)
hodu diṭṭhaṃ (BhSv_2:39)
  {prakāśam} haḷā evvaṃ ujjaiṇīo jaṇo mantedi (BhSv_2:40)
[āryaputrapakṣapātenātikrāntaḥ samudācāraḥ | kim idānīṃ kariṣyāmi | bhavatu dṛṣṭam | haḷā evam ujjayinīyo jano mantrayate | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} By taking the noble lord's side, I have overstepped propriety. What shall I do now? Well, so be it.
  {Aloud:} Dear friend, the people of <s>Ujjayinī</s> say so.
[By taking the noble lord's side, I have overstepped propriety. What shall I do now? Well, so be it. Dear friend, the people of <s>Ujjayinī</s> say so.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - jujjai (BhSv_2:41)
ṇa khu eso ujjaiṇīduḷḷaho (BhSv_2:42)
savvajaṇamaṇobhirāmaṃ khu sobhaggaṃ ṇāma (BhSv_2:43)
[yujyate | na khalv eṣa ujjayinīdurlabhaḥ | sarvajanamano'bhirāmaṃ khalu saubhāgyaṃ nāma | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — That is fitting. This [good fortune] is surely not exclusive to <s>Ujjayinī</s>. Good fortune is that which delights the minds of all people.
[That is fitting. This is surely not exclusive to <s>Ujjayinī</s>. Good fortune is that which delights the minds of all people.]

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati dhātrī (BhSv_2:44)}
*{dhātrī}* - jedu bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_2:45)
bhaṭṭidārie diṇṇāsi (BhSv_2:46)
[jayatu bhartṛdārikā | bhartṛdārike dattāsi | ]

*{vāsavadattā}* - ayye kassa (BhSv_2:47)
[ārye kasmai | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Noble lady, to whom?
[Noble lady, to whom?]

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - vaccharāassa udaaṇassa (BhSv_2:48)
[vatsarājāyodayanāya | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — To <s>Udayana</s>, the king of <s>Vatsa</s>.
[To <s>Udayana</s>, the king of <s>Vatsa</s>.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - aha kusaḷī so rāā (BhSv_2:49)
[atha kuśalī sa rājā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — And is that king well?
[And is that king well?]

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - kusaḷī so āado (BhSv_2:50)
tassa bhaṭṭidāriā paḍicchidā a (BhSv_2:51)
[kuśalī sa āgataḥ | tasya bhartṛdārikā pratīṣṭā ca | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — He is well; he has arrived. And the princess is expected by him.
[He is well; he has arrived. And the princess is expected by him.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - accāhidaṃ (BhSv_2:52)
[atyāhitam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — How terrible!
[How terrible!]

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - kiṃ ettha accāhidaṃ (BhSv_2:53)
[kim atrātyāhitam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — What is terrible about this?
[What is terrible about this?]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ṇa hu kiñci (BhSv_2:54)
taha ṇāma santappia udāsīṇo hodi tti (BhSv_2:55)
[na khalu kiñcit | tathā nāma santapyodāsīno bhavatīti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Nothing at all. [I meant] that one who has suffered so should now be indifferent [to his former wife].
[Nothing at all. That one who has suffered so should now be indifferent.]

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - ayye āamappahāṇāṇi suḷahapayyavatthāṇāṇi mahāpurusahiaāṇi honti (BhSv_2:56)
[ārye āgamapradhānāni sulabhaparyavasthānāni mahāpuruṣahṛdayāni bhavanti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — Noble lady, the hearts of great men are guided by [higher] purpose, easily find composure, and are [always] noble.
[Noble lady, the hearts of great men are guided by purpose, easily find composure, and are noble.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ayye saaṃ evva teṇa varidā (BhSv_2:57)
[ārye svayam eva tena varitā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Noble lady, did he himself choose her?
[Noble lady, did he himself choose her?]

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - ṇahi ṇahi (BhSv_2:58)
aṇṇappaoaṇeṇa iha āadassa abhijaṇaviññāṇavaorūvaṃ pekkhia saaṃ evva mahārāeṇa diṇṇā (BhSv_2:59)
[nahi nahi | anyaprayojanenehāgatasyābhijanavijñānavayorūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā svayam eva mahārājena dattā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — No, no! He had come here for another purpose, and when the great king saw his noble birth, wisdom, age, and appearance, he himself gave [the princess to him].
[No, no! He had come here for another purpose, and when the great king saw his noble birth, wisdom, age, and appearance, he himself gave her.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} evvaṃ (BhSv_2:60)
aṇavaraddho dāṇiṃ ettha ayyautto (BhSv_2:61)
[evam | anaparāddha idānīm atrāryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} So it is! Then the noble lord is blameless in this matter.
[So it is! Then the noble lord is blameless in this matter.]

body.text:
{praviśyāparā}
*{ceṭī}* - tuvaradu tuvaradu dāva ayyā (BhSv_2:62)
ajja evva kiḷa sobhaṇaṃ ṇakkhattaṃ (BhSv_2:63)
ajja evva koduamaṅgaḷaṃ kādavvaṃ tti ahmāṇaṃ bhaṭṭiṇī bhaṇādi (BhSv_2:64)
[tvaratāṃ tvaratāṃ tāvad āryā | adyaiva kila śobhanaṃ nakṣatram | adyaiva kautukamaṅgalaṃ kartavyam ity asmākaṃ bhaṭṭinī bhaṇati | ]

*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} jaha jaha tuvaradi taha taha andhīkaredi me hiaaṃ (BhSv_2:65)
[yathā yathā tvarate tathā tathāndhīkaroti me hṛdayam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} The more she hastens, the more my heart is darkened.
[The more she hastens, the more my heart is darkened.]

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - edu edu bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_2:66)
[etv etu bhartṛdārikā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — Come, come, princess!
[Come, come, princess!]

body.text: {niṣkrāntāḥ sarve (BhSv_2:67)}
body.translated_text: {All exit.}

body.text: dvitīyo 'ṅkaḥ |
body.translated_text: End of the Second Act.

body.text:
atha tṛtīyo 'ṅkaḥ |
  {tataḥ praviśati vicintayantī vāsavadattā (BhSv_3:1)}
*{vāsavadattā}* - vivāhāmodasaṅkuḷe anteuracaussāḷe parittajia padumāvadiṃ iha āadahmi pamadavaṇaṃ (BhSv_3:2)
jāva dāṇiṃ bhāadheaṇivvuttaṃ duḥkhaṃ viṇodemi (BhSv_3:3)
  {parikramya} aho accāhidaṃ (BhSv_3:4)
ayyautto vi ṇāma parakerao saṃvutto (BhSv_3:5)
jāva uvavisāmi (BhSv_3:6)
  {upaviśya} dhaññā khu cakkavāavahū jā aṇṇoṇṇavirahidā ṇa jīvai (BhSv_3:7)
ṇa khu ahaṃ pāṇāṇi parittajāmi (BhSv_3:8)
ayyauttaṃ pekkhāmi tti ediṇā maṇoraheṇa jīvāmi mandabhāā (BhSv_3:9)
[vivāhāmodasaṅkule antaḥpuracatuśśāle parityajya padmāvatīm ihāgatāsmi pramadavanam | yāvad idānīṃ bhāgadheyanirvṛttaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinodayāmi | aho atyāhitam | āryaputro 'pi nāma parakīyaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | yāvad upaviśāmi | dhanyā khalu cakravākavadhūḥ yānyonyavirahitā na jīvati | na khalv ahaṃ prāṇān parityajāmi | āryaputraṃ paśyāmīty etena manorathena jīvāmi mandabhāgā | ]
body.translated_text:
Now begins the Third Act.
  {Then enters <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, deep in thought.}
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Leaving <s>Padmāvatī</s> in the inner courtyard bustling with wedding festivities, I have come here to the pleasure garden.
Let me now dispel the sorrow brought about by fate.
  {Walking about} Ah, how terrible!
Even the noble lord has become another's.
Let me sit down.
  {Sitting} Blessed indeed is the <s>cakravāka</s> bird's mate, who does not live when separated from her beloved.
But I do not give up my life.
'I shall see the noble lord' — with this hope alone do I, the unfortunate one, go on living.
[Leaving <s>Padmāvatī</s> in the inner courtyard bustling with wedding festivities, I have come here to the pleasure garden. Let me now dispel the sorrow brought about by fate. Ah, how terrible! Even the noble lord has become another's. Let me sit down. Blessed indeed is the <s>cakravāka</s> bird's mate, who does not live when separated from her beloved. But I do not give up my life. 'I shall see the noble lord' — with this hope alone do I, the unfortunate one, go on living.]

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati puṣpāṇi gṛhītvā ceṭī (BhSv_3:10)}
*{ceṭī}* - kahiṃṇukhu gadā ayyā āvantiā (BhSv_3:11)
  {parikramyāvalokya} ammo iaṃ cintāsuññahiaā ṇīhārapaḍihadacandaḷehā via amaṇḍidabhaddaaṃ vesaṃ dhāraandī piaṅgusiḷāpaṭṭae uvaviṭṭhā (BhSv_3:12)
jāva uvasappāmi (BhSv_3:13)
  {upasṛtya} ayye āvantie ko kāḷo tumaṃ aṇṇesāmi (BhSv_3:14)
[kva nu khalu gatā āryāvantikā | ammo iyaṃ cintāśūnyahṛdayā nīhārapratihatacandralekhevāmaṇḍitabhadrakaṃ veṣaṃ dhārayantī priyaṅguśilāpaṭṭake upaviṣṭā | yāvad upasarpāmi | ārye āvantike kaḥ kālaḥ tvām anviṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text:
{Then enters a maidservant, carrying flowers.}
*{Maid}* — Where indeed has the noble lady of <s>Avantī</s> gone?
  {Walking about and looking} Oh! Here she sits on a slab of <s>priyaṅgu</s> stone, her heart emptied by worry, wearing her ornaments unadorned, like a crescent moon obscured by mist.
Let me approach her.
  {Approaching} Noble lady of <s>Avantī</s>, how long have I been searching for you!
[Where indeed has the noble lady of <s>Avantī</s> gone? Oh! Here she sits on a slab of <s>priyaṅgu</s> stone, her heart emptied by worry, wearing her auspicious ornaments unadorned, like a crescent moon obscured by mist. Let me approach her. Noble lady of <s>Avantī</s>, how long have I been searching for you!]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - kiṇṇimittaṃ (BhSv_3:15)
[kinnimittam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — For what reason?
[For what reason?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - ahmāaṃ bhaṭṭiṇī bhaṇādi mahākuḷappasūdā siṇiddhā ṇiuṇā tti (BhSv_3:16)
imaṃ dāva koduamāḷiaṃ guhmadu ayyā (BhSv_3:17)
[asmākaṃ bhaṭṭinī bhaṇati mahākulaprasūtā snigdhā nipuṇeti | imāṃ tāvat kautukamālikāṃ gumphatv āryā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Our mistress says: 'She is born of a great family, affectionate, and skilled.'
Now, let the noble lady string this festive garland.
[Our mistress says: 'She is born of a great family, affectionate, and skilled.' Now, let the noble lady string this festive garland.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - aha kassa kiḷa guhmidavvaṃ (BhSv_3:18)
[atha kasmai kila gumphitavyam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — And for whom, pray, is it to be strung?
[And for whom, pray, is it to be strung?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - ahmāaṃ bhaṭṭidāriāe (BhSv_3:19)
[asmākaṃ bhartṛdārikāyai | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — For our young mistress.
[For our young mistress.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} edaṃ pi mae kattavvaṃ āsī (BhSv_3:20)
aho akaruṇā khu issarā (BhSv_3:21)
[etad api mayā kartavyam āsīt | aho akaruṇāḥ khalv īśvarāḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside} This too should have been done by me.
Ah, how merciless indeed are the lords of fate!
[This too should have been done by me. Ah, how merciless indeed are the lords of fate!]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - ayye mā dāṇiṃ aññaṃ cintia (BhSv_3:22)
eso jāmāduo maṇibhūmīe hṇāadi (BhSv_3:23)
sigghaṃ dāva guhmadu ayyā (BhSv_3:24)
[ārye medānīm anyac cintayitvā | eṣa jāmātā maṇibhūmyāṃ snāyati | śīghraṃ tāvad gumphatv āryā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Noble lady, do not think of other things now.
The bridegroom is bathing in the jeweled hall.
Let the noble lady string it quickly.
[Noble lady, do not think of other things now. The bridegroom is bathing in the jeweled hall. Let the noble lady string it quickly.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} ṇa sukkuṇomi aṇṇaṃ cinteduṃ (BhSv_3:25)
  {prakāśam (BhSv_3:26)}
haḷā kiṃ diṭṭho jāmāduo (BhSv_3:27)
[na śaknomy anyac cintayitum | halā kiṃ dṛṣṭo jāmātā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside} I cannot think of anything else.
  {Aloud}
My dear, has the bridegroom been seen?
[I cannot think of anything else. My dear, has the bridegroom been seen?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - āma diṭṭho bhaṭṭiidāriāe siṇeheṇa ahmāaṃ kaudūhaḷeṇa a (BhSv_3:28)
[āma dṛṣṭo bhartṛdārikāyāḥ snehenāsmākaṃ kautūhalena ca | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Yes, seen — by the young mistress with affection, by us with curiosity.
[Yes, seen — by the young mistress with affection, by us with curiosity.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - kīdiso jāmāduo (BhSv_3:29)
[kīdṛśo jāmātā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — What is the bridegroom like?
[What is the bridegroom like?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - ayye bhaṇāmi dāva ṇa īriso diṭṭhapuruvo (BhSv_3:30)
[ārye bhaṇāmi tāvad nedṛśo dṛṣṭapūrvaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Noble lady, let me say — none like him has ever been seen before.
[Noble lady, let me say — none like him has ever been seen before.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - haḷā bhaṇāhi bhaṇāhi kiṃ daṃsaṇīo (BhSv_3:31)
[halā bhaṇa bhaṇa kiṃ darśanīyaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — My dear, speak, speak! Is he handsome?
[My dear, speak, speak! Is he handsome?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - sakkaṃ bhaṇiduṃ saracāvahīṇo kāmadevo tti (BhSv_3:32)
[śakyaṃ bhaṇituṃ śaracāpahīnaḥ kāmadeva iti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — One may say: he is <s>Kāmadeva</s> (the god of love) without his bow and arrows.
[One may say: he is <s>Kāmadeva</s> (the god of love) without his bow and arrows.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - hodu ettaaṃ (BhSv_3:33)
[bhavatv etāvat | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Enough of that.
[Enough of that.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - kiṇṇimittaṃ vāresi (BhSv_3:34)
[kinnimittaṃ vārayasi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Why do you stop me?
[Why do you stop me?]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ajuttaṃ parapurusasaṅkittaṇaṃ soduṃ (BhSv_3:35)
[ayuktaṃ parapuruṣasaṅkīrtanaṃ śrotum | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — It is improper to hear praise of another's husband.
[It is improper to hear praise of another's husband.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - teṇa hi guhmadu ayyā sigghaṃ (BhSv_3:36)
[tena hi gumphatv āryā śīghram | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Then let the noble lady string it quickly.
[Then let the noble lady string it quickly.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - iaṃ guhmāmi (BhSv_3:37)
āṇehi dāva (BhSv_3:38)
[iyaṃ gumphāmi | ānaya tāvat | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — I shall string it.
Bring it here.
[I shall string it. Bring it here.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - gahṇadu ayyā (BhSv_3:39)
[gṛhṇātv āryā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Let the noble lady take it.
[Let the noble lady take it.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {varjayitvā vilokya} iaṃ dāva osahaṃ kiṃ ṇāma (BhSv_3:40)
[idaṃ tāvad auṣadhaṃ kiṃ nāma | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Picking out and examining} Now, this herb — what is its name?
[Now, this herb — what is its name?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - avihavākaraṇaṃ ṇāma (BhSv_3:41)
[avidhavākaraṇaṃ nāma | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — It is called <s>avidhavākaraṇa</s> ('that which prevents widowhood').
[It is called <s>avidhavākaraṇa</s> ('that which prevents widowhood').]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} idaṃ bahuso guhmidavvaṃ mama a padumāvadīe a (BhSv_3:42)
  {prakāśam} imaṃ dāva osahaṃ kiṃ ṇāma (BhSv_3:43)
[idaṃ bahuśo gumphitavyaṃ mama ca padmāvatyāś ca | idaṃ tāvad auṣadhaṃ kiṃ nāma | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside} This should be strung many times over, both for me and for <s>Padmāvatī</s>.
  {Aloud} And this herb — what is its name?
[This should be strung many times over, both for me and for <s>Padmāvatī</s>. And this herb — what is its name?]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - savattimaddaṇaṃ ṇāma (BhSv_3:44)
[sapatnīmardanaṃ nāma | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — It is called <s>sapatnīmardana</s> ('that which crushes a co-wife').
[It is called <s>sapatnīmardana</s> ('that which crushes a co-wife').]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - idaṃ ṇa guhmidavvaṃ (BhSv_3:45)
[idaṃ na gumphitavyam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — This one should not be strung.
[This one should not be strung.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - kīsa (BhSv_3:46)
[kasmāt | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Why?
[Why?]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - uvaradā tassa bhayyā taṃ ṇippaoaṇaṃ tti (BhSv_3:47)
[uparatā tasya bhāryā tan niṣprayojanam iti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — His [former] wife has passed away; therefore it serves no purpose.
[His wife has passed away; therefore it serves no purpose.]

body.text:
{praviśyāparā}
*{ceṭī}* - tuvaradu tuvaradu ayyā (BhSv_3:48)
eso jāmāduo avihavāhi abbhantaracaussāḷaṃ pavesīadi (BhSv_3:49)
[tvaratāṃ tvaratām āryā | eṣa jāmātā avidhavābhir abhyantaracatuśśālaṃ praveśyate | ]
body.translated_text:
{Another maid enters.}
*{Maid}* — Hurry, hurry, noble lady!
The bridegroom is being led by the married women into the inner courtyard.
[Let the noble lady hurry, hurry! The bridegroom is being led by the married women into the inner courtyard.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ai vadāmi gahṇa edaṃ (BhSv_3:50)
[ayi vadāmi gṛhāṇaitat | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Oh, I say — take this.
[Oh, I say — take this.]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - sohaṇaṃ (BhSv_3:51)
ayye gacchāmi dāva ahaṃ (BhSv_3:52)
[śobhaṇaṃ | ārye gacchāmi tāvad aham | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maid}* — Splendid.
Noble lady, I shall go now.
[Splendid. Noble lady, I shall go now.]

body.text:
{ubhe niṣkrānte (BhSv_3:53)}
*{vāsavadattā}* - gadā esā (BhSv_3:54)
aho accāhidaṃ (BhSv_3:55)
ayyautto vi ṇāma parakerao saṃvutto (BhSv_3:56)
avidā sayyāe mama dukkhaṃ viṇodemi jadi ṇiddaṃ ḷabhāmi (BhSv_3:57)
[gataiṣā | aho atyāhitam | āryaputro 'pi nāma parakīyaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | avidā śayyāyāṃ mama duḥkhaṃ vinodayāmi yadi nidrāṃ labhe | ]
body.translated_text:
{Both exit.}
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — She has gone.
Ah, how terrible!
Even the noble lord has become another's.
On a lonely bed I shall try to ease my sorrow, if I can find sleep.
[She has gone. Ah, how terrible! Even the noble lord has become another's. On a lonely bed I shall try to ease my sorrow, if I can find sleep.]

body.text:
{niṣkrāntā (BhSv_3:58)}
tṛtīyo 'ṅkaḥ |
body.translated_text:
{She exits.}
End of the Third Act.

body.text:
atha caturtho 'ṅkaḥ |
  {tataḥ praviśati vidūṣakaḥ (BhSv_4.0:1)}
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* -
  {saharṣam} bho diṭṭhiā tattahodo vaccharāassa abhippedavivāhamaṅgaḷaramaṇijjo kāḷo diṭṭho (BhSv_4.0:2)
bho ko ṇāma edaṃ jāṇādi tādise vayaṃ aṇatthasaḷiḷāvatte pakkhittā uṇa ummajjissāmo tti (BhSv_4.0:3)
idāṇiṃ pāsādesu vasīadi andeuradigghiāsu hṇāīadi pakidimaurasuumārāṇi modaakhajjaāṇi khajjīanti tti aṇaccharasaṃvāso uttarakuruvāso mae aṇubhavīadi (BhSv_4.0:4)
ekko khu mahanto doso mama āhāro suṭṭhu ṇa pariṇamadi (BhSv_4.0:5)
suppacchadaṇāe sayyāe ṇiddaṃ ṇa ḷabhāmi jaha vādasoṇidaṃ abhido via vattadi tti pekkhāmi (BhSv_4.0:6)
bho suhaṃ ṇāma aparibhūdaṃ akaḷḷavattaṃ ca (BhSv_4.0:7)
[bhoḥ diṣṭyā tatrabhavato vatsarājasyābhipretavivāhamaṅgalaramaṇīyaḥ kālo dṛṣṭaḥ | bhoḥ ko nāmaitaj jānāti tādṛśe vayam anarthasalilāvarte prakṣiptāḥ punar unmaṅkṣyāma iti | idānīṃ prāsādeṣūṣyate antaḥpuradīrghikāsu snāyate prakṛtimadhurasukumārāṇi modakakhādyāni khādyanta ity anapsarassaṃvāsa uttarakuruvāso mayānubhūyate | ekaḥ khalu mahān doṣaḥ mamāhāraḥ suṣṭhu na pariṇamati supracchadanāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ nidrāṃ na labhe yathā vātaśoṇitam abhita iva vartata iti paśyāmi | bhoḥ sukhaṃ nāmayaparibhūtamakalyavartaṃ ca | ]
body.translated_text: Now, Act Four. {Enter the Jester.} *{Jester}* — {joyfully} Ah, how fortunate! The time for the desired wedding festivities of the venerable Prince <s>Vatsarāja</s> has arrived! Who indeed would have known that, cast as we were into such a whirlpool of misfortune, we would surface again! Now we dwell in palaces, bathe in the inner-chamber pools, eat sweetmeats that are naturally sweet and delicate—I am experiencing a life like dwelling in the <s>Uttarakurus</s>, only without the <s>Apsarases</s>! One great fault, though: my food does not digest well. On a bed with fine coverlets I cannot get sleep—I perceive something like blood-wind disease raging all around. Ah, happiness is that which is without humiliation and without illness!

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati ceṭī (BhSv_4.0:8)}
*{ceṭī}* - kahiṃṇukhu gado ayyavasantao (BhSv_4.0:9)
  {parikramyāvalokya} ahmo eso ayyavasantao (BhSv_4.0:10)
  {upagamya} ayya vasantaa ko kāḷo tumaṃ aṇṇesāmi (BhSv_4.0:11)
[kutra nu khalu gata āryavasantakaḥ | aho eṣa āryavasantakaḥ | ārya vasantaka kaḥ kālas tvām anviṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: {Enter the maid.} *{Maid}* — Where has noble <s>Vasantaka</s> gone? {Walking about and looking} Ah, there is noble <s>Vasantaka</s>. {Approaching} Noble <s>Vasantaka</s>, what a time I have been searching for you!

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* -
  {dṛṣṭvā} kiṃṇimittaṃ bhadde maṃ aṇṇesasi (BhSv_4.0:12)
[kinnimittaṃ bhadre mām anviṣyasi | ]
body.translated_text: *{Jester}* — {seeing her} For what reason, good lady, are you looking for me?

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - ahmāṇaṃ bhaṭṭiṇī bhaṇādi avi hṇādo jāmāduo tti (BhSv_4.0:13)
[asmākaṃ bhaṭṭinī bhaṇati api snāto jāmāteti | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Our mistress asks: 'Has the son-in-law bathed yet?'

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kiṃṇimittaṃ bhodi pucchadi (BhSv_4.0:14)
[kinnimittaṃ bhavati pṛcchati | ]
body.translated_text: *{Jester}* — For what reason does the lady ask?

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - kimaṇṇaṃ (BhSv_4.0:15)
sumaṇāvaṇṇaaṃ āṇemi tti (BhSv_4.0:16)
[kim anyat | sumanovarṇakam ānayāmīti | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — What else? 'I shall bring the jasmine unguent,' she says.

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - hṇādo tattabhavaṃ (BhSv_4.0:17)
savvaṃ āṇedu bhodī vajjia bhoaṇaṃ (BhSv_4.0:18)
[snātas tatrabhavān | sarvam ānayatu bhavatī varjayitvā bhojanam | ]
body.translated_text: *{Jester}* — The venerable one has bathed. Let the lady bring everything—except food.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - kiṃṇimittaṃ vāresi bhoaṇaṃ (BhSv_4.0:19)
[kinnimittaṃ vārayasi bhojanam | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Why do you refuse food?

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - adhaṇṇassa mama koiḷāṇaṃ akkhiparivaṭṭo via kukkhiparivaṭṭo saṃvutto (BhSv_4.0:20)
[adhanyasya mama kokilānām akṣiparivarta iva kukṣiparivartaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{Jester}* — Unfortunate me! Like the rolling of the cuckoos' eyes, a rolling of my belly has occurred.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - īdiso evva hohi (BhSv_4.0:21)
[īdṛśa eva bhava | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Just stay as you are!

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - gacchadu bhodī (BhSv_4.0:22)
jāva ahaṃ vi tattahodo saāsaṃ gacchāmi (BhSv_4.0:23)
[gacchatu bhavatī | yāvad aham api tatrabhavataḥ sakāśaṃ gacchāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{Jester}* — Let the lady go. Meanwhile, I too shall go to the presence of the venerable one.

body.text:
{niṣkrāntau (BhSv_4.0:24)} praveśakaḥ |
  {tataḥ praviśati saparivārā padmāvatī āvantikāveṣadhāriṇī vāsavadattā ca (BhSv_4.0:25)}
*{ceṭī}* - kiṃṇimittaṃ bhaṭṭidāriā pamadavaṇaṃ āadā (BhSv_4.0:26)
[kinnimittaṃ bhartṛdārikā pramadavanam āgatā | ]
body.translated_text: {Both exit.} Interlude. {Then enter <s>Padmāvatī</s> with her retinue, and <s>Vāsavadattā</s> wearing the dress of an <s>Avantī</s> woman.} *{Maid}* — Why has the princess come to the pleasure garden?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - haḷā tāṇi dāva sehāḷiāguhmaāṇi pekkhāmi kusumidāṇi vā ṇa vetti (BhSv_4.0:27)
[haḷā te tāvad śephālikāgulmakāḥ paśyāmi kusumitā vā na veti | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Dear friend, let me see those <s>śephālikā</s> (night-jasmine) bushes—whether they have blossomed or not.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie tāṇi kusumidāṇi ṇāma pavāḷantaridehiṃ via mottiālambaehiṃ āidāṇi kusumehiṃ (BhSv_4.0:28)
[bhartṛdārike te kusumitā nāma pravālāntaritair iva mauktikalambakair ācitāḥ kusumaiḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Princess, they have indeed blossomed—they are laden with flowers like pearl pendants set between coral [stems].

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - haḷā jadi evvaṃ kiṃ dāṇiṃ viḷambesi (BhSv_4.0:29)
[halā yady evaṃ kim idānīṃ vilambase | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Dear friend, if so, why do you delay?

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - teṇa hi imassiṃ siḷāvaṭṭae muhuttaaṃ upavisadu bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_4.0:30)
jāva ahaṃ vi kusumāvacaaṃ karemi (BhSv_4.0:31)
[tena hy asmin śilāpaṭṭake muhūrtakam upaviśatu bhartṛdārikā | yāvad aham api kusumāvacayaṃ karomi | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Then let the princess sit for a moment on this stone slab, while I too gather flowers.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye kiṃ ettha upavisāmo (BhSv_4.0:32)
[ārye kim atropaviśāvaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble lady, shall we sit here?

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - evvaṃ hodu (BhSv_4.0:33)
[evaṃ bhavatu | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Let it be so.

body.text:
{ubhe upaviśataḥ (BhSv_4.0:34)}
*{ceṭī}* -
  {tathā kṛtvā} pekkhadu pekkhadu bhaṭṭidāriā addhāmaṇasiḷāvaṭṭaehiṃ via sehāḷiākusumehi pūriaṃ me añjaḷiṃ (BhSv_4.0:35)
[paśyatu paśyatu bhartṛdārikā ardhamanaśśilāpaṭṭakair iva śephālikākusumaiḥ pūritaṃ me 'ñjalim | ]
body.translated_text: {Both sit down.} *{Maid}* — {doing so} Look, look, princess! My cupped hands are filled with <s>śephālikā</s> flowers, like half-formed moonstones!

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* -
  {dṛṣṭvā} aho viittadā kusumāṇaṃ (BhSv_4.0:36)
pekkhadu pekkhadu ayyā (BhSv_4.0:37)
[aho vicitratā kusumānām | paśyatu paśyatv āryā | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — {looking} Oh, how varied the flowers are! Look, look, noble lady!

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - aho dassaṇīadā kusumāṇaṃ (BhSv_4.0:38)
[aho darśanīyatā kusumānām | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Oh, how beautiful the flowers are!

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie kiṃ bhūyo avaiṇussaṃ (BhSv_4.0:39)
[bhartṛdārike kiṃ bhūyo 'vaceṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Princess, shall I gather more?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - haḷā mā mā bhūyo avaiṇia (BhSv_4.0:40)
[haḷā mā mā bhūyo 'vacitya | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Dear friend, no, no! Do not gather more.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - haḷā kiṃṇimittaṃ vāresi (BhSv_4.0:41)
[haḷā kinnimittaṃ vārayasi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Dear friend, why do you stop her?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyautto iha āacchia imaṃ kusumasamiddhiṃ pekkhia sammāṇidā bhaveaṃ (BhSv_4.0:42)
[āryaputra ihāgatyemāṃ kusumasamṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sammānitā bhaveyam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — If the noble prince were to come here and see this abundance of flowers, I would be honored.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - haḷā pio de bhattā (BhSv_4.0:43)
[haḷā priyas te bhartā | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Dear friend, your husband is dear to you.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye ṇa āṇāmi ayyautteṇa virahidā ukkaṇṭhidā homi (BhSv_4.0:44)
[ārye na jānāmi āryaputreṇa virahitotkaṇṭhitā bhavāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble lady, I do not know [why], but separated from the noble prince, I become anxious.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} dukkharaṃ khu ahaṃ karemi (BhSv_4.0:45)
iaṃ vi ṇāma evvaṃ mantedi (BhSv_4.0:46)
[duṣkaraṃ khalv ahaṃ karomi | iyam api nāmaivaṃ mantrayate | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {aside} I am indeed doing something difficult. Even she speaks thus!

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - abhijādaṃ khu bhaṭṭidāriāe mantidaṃ pio me bhattatti (BhSv_4.0:47)
[abhijātaṃ khalu bhartṛdārikayā mantritaṃ priyo me bharteti | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — It is worthy of the princess to say: 'My husband is dear to me.'

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ekko khu me sandeho (BhSv_4.0:48)
[ekaḥ khalu me sandehaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — I have one doubt, though.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - kiṃ kiṃ (BhSv_4.0:49)
[kiṃ kim | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — What, what?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - jaha mama ayyautto taha evva ayyāe vāsavadattāe tti (BhSv_4.0:50)
[yathā mamāryaputras tathaivāryāyā vāsavadattāyā iti | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Whether the noble prince feels the same toward the noble <s>Vāsavadattā</s> as he does toward me.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - ado vi ahiaṃ (BhSv_4.0:51)
[ato 'py adhikam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Even more so.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - kahaṃ tuvaṃ jāṇāsi (BhSv_4.0:52)
[kathaṃ tvaṃ jānāsi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — How do you know?

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} haṃ ayyauttapakkhavādeṇa adikkando samudāāro (BhSv_4.0:53)
evvaṃ dāva bhaṇissaṃ (BhSv_4.0:54)
  {prakāśam} jai appo siṇeho sā sajaṇaṃ ṇa parittajadi (BhSv_4.0:55)
[ham āryaputrapakṣapātenātikrāntaḥ samudācāraḥ | evaṃ tāvad bhaṇiṣyāmi | yady alpaḥ snehaḥ sā svajanaṃ na parityajati | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {aside} Ah, by speaking in the noble prince's favor, propriety has been overstepped. Let me say this then: {aloud} If her love is slight, she would not abandon her own people.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - hodavvaṃ (BhSv_4.0:56)
[bhavitavyam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — That must be so.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie sāhu bhaṭṭāraṃ bhaṇāhi ahaṃ pi vīṇaṃ sikkhissāmi tti (BhSv_4.0:57)
[bhartṛdārike sādhu bhartāraṃ bhaṇa aham api vīṇāṃ śikṣiṣya iti | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Noble princess, it would be good if you told the lord that I too wish to learn the <s>vīṇā</s>.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - utto mae ayyautto (BhSv_4.0:58)
[ukto mayāryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — I have told the noble prince.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - tado kiṃ bhaṇidaṃ (BhSv_4.0:59)
[tataḥ kiṃ bhaṇitam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Then what did he say?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - abhaṇia kiñci digghaṃ ṇissasia tuhṇīo saṃvutto (BhSv_4.0:60)
[abhaṇitvā kiñcid dīrghaṃ niḥśvasya tūṣṇīkaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Without saying anything, he heaved a long sigh and fell silent.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - tado tuvaṃ kiṃ via takkesi (BhSv_4.0:61)
[tatas tvaṃ kim iva tarkayasi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Then what do you surmise?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - takkemi ayyāe vāsavadattāe guṇāṇi sumaria dakkhiṇṇadāe mama aggado ṇa rodidi tti (BhSv_4.0:62)
[tarkayāmy āryāyā vāsavadattāyā guṇān smṛtvā dakṣiṇyatayā mamāgrato na roditīti | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — I surmise that, remembering the virtues of the noble lady <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, out of noble-heartedness he does not weep before me.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} dhaññā khu hmi jadi evvaṃ saccaṃ bhave (BhSv_4.0:63)
[dhanyā khalv asmi yady evaṃ satyaṃ bhavet | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {Aside} Blessed indeed am I, if this be true.

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati rājā vidūṣakaś ca (BhSv_4.0:64)}
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - hī hī (BhSv_4.0:65)
paciapaḍiabandhujīvakusumaviraḷavādaramaṇijjaṃ pamadavaṇaṃ (BhSv_4.0:66)
ido dāva bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.0:67)
[hī hī | pracitapatitabandhujīvakusumaviralapātaramaṇīyaṃ pramadavanam | itas tāvad bhavān | ]
body.translated_text: {Then enter the King and the Jester.} *{Jester}* — Ha ha! The pleasure garden, delightful with its scattered <s>bandhujīvaka</s> flowers ripened and fallen,

body.text: *{rājā}* - vayasya vasantaka ayam ayam āgacchāmi (BhSv_4.0:68)
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Friend <s>Vasantaka</s>, here, here I come.

body.text: kāmenojjayinīṃ gate mayi tadā kām apy avasthāṃ gate dṛṣṭvā svairam avantirājatanayāṃ pañceṣavaḥ pātitāḥ &

children.text: tair adyāpi saśalyam eva hṛdayaṃ bhūyaś ca viddhā vayaṃ pañceṣur madano yadā katham ayaṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ śaraḥ pātitaḥ // BhSv_4.1 //
children.translated_text: Even now my heart remains pierced by those shafts, and yet again I am struck — if the five-arrowed <s>Madana</s> (Love) has [only] five arrows, how has this sixth shaft been discharged? (4.1)

body.translated_text: When I went to <s>Ujjayinī</s> driven by desire, I fell into some indescribable state upon freely beholding the daughter of the king of <s>Avanti</s> — the five-arrowed one (<s>Kāma</s>) shot his arrows.

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kahiṃṇukhu gadā tattahodī padumāvadī ḷadāmaṇḍavaṃ gadā bhave udāho asaṇakusumasañcidaṃ vagghacammāvaguṇṭhidaṃ via pavvadatiḷaaṃ ṇāma siḷāpaṭṭaaṃ gadā bhave ādu adhiakaḍuagandhasattacchadavaṇaṃ paviṭṭhā bhave ahava āḷihidamiapakkhisaṅkuḷaṃ dārupavvadaaṃ gadā bhave (BhSv_4.1:1)
  {ūrdhvam avalokya} hī hī saraakāḷaṇimmaḷe antarikkhe pasādiabaḷadevabāhudaṃsaṇīaṃ sārasapantiṃ jāva samāhidaṃ gacchantiṃ pekkhadu dāva bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.1:2)
[kutra nu khalu gatā tatrabhavatī padmāvatī latāmaṇḍapaṃ gatā bhaved utāho asanakusumasañcitaṃ vyāghracarmāvaguṇṭhitam iva parvatatilakaṃ nāma śilāpaṭṭakaṃ gatā bhaved athavā adhikakaṭukagandhasaptacchadavanaṃ praviṣṭā bhaved athavālikhitamṛgapakṣisaṅkulaṃ dāruparvatakaṃ gatā bhavet | hī hī śaratkālanirmale 'ntarikṣe prasāditabaladevabāhudarśanīyāṃ sārasapaṅktiṃ yāvat samāhitaṃ gacchantīṃ paśyatu tāvad bhavān | ]
body.translated_text: *{Jester}* — Where has the noble lady <s>Padmāvatī</s> gone? Has she gone to the vine-bower, or perhaps to the mountain terrace covered with a tiger-skin, strewn with the flowers of the <s>aśoka</s> tree?

body.text: *{rājā}* - vayasya paśyāmyenām
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Friend, let me behold her —

body.text: ṛjvāyatāṃ ca viralāṃ ca natonnatāṃ ca saptarṣivaṃśakuṭilāṃ ca nivartaneṣu &

children.text: nirmucyamānabhujagodaranirmalasya sīmām ivāmbaratalasya vibhajyamānām // BhSv_4.2 //
children.translated_text: Like the boundary line of the firmament, being divided, as clear as the skin being shed by a serpent. (4.2)

body.translated_text: Straight and extended, and sparse, and rising and falling, and curved like the line of the Seven Sages (<s>Saptarṣi</s>, the Great Bear constellation) at its turnings,

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - pekkhadu pekkhadu bhaṭṭidāriā edaṃ kokaṇadamāḷāpaṇḍararamaṇīaṃ sārasapantiṃ jāva samāhidaṃ gacchantiṃ (BhSv_4.2:1)
ammo bhaṭṭā (BhSv_4.2:2)
[paśyatu paśyatu bhartṛdārikā etāṃ kokanadamālāpāṇḍuraramaṇīyāṃ sārasapaṅktiṃ yāvat samāhitaṃ gacchantīm | ahmo bhartā | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Look, look, noble princess — see this line of <s>sārasa</s> cranes, beautiful with garlands of white <s>kokanada</s> (red lotus) flowers, moving together in formation. Oh! The lord!

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - haṃ ayyautto (BhSv_4.2:3)
ayye tava kāraṇādo ayyauttadaṃsaṇaṃ pariharāmi (BhSv_4.2:4)
tā imaṃ dāva māhavīḷadāmaṇḍavaṃ pavisāmo (BhSv_4.2:5)
[ham āryaputraḥ | ārye tava kāraṇād āryaputradarśanaṃ pariharāmi | tad imaṃ tāvan mādhavīlatāmaṇḍapaṃ praviśāmaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — What! The noble prince! Noble lady, on your account I avoid being seen by the noble prince. So let us first enter this <s>mādhavī</s>-vine bower.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - evvaṃ hodu (BhSv_4.2:6)
[evaṃ bhavatu | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Let it be so.
{They do so.} *{Jester}* — The noble lady <s>Padmāvatī</s> was here and has departed.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kathaṃ bhavān jānāti (BhSv_4.2:9)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - imāṇi avaidakusumāṇi sephāḷiāgucchaāṇi pekkhadu dāva bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.2:10)
[imān apacitakusumān śephālikāgucchakān prekṣatāṃ tāvad bhavān | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — How does sir know this? *{Jester}* — Look, sir, at these flowers picked from the trees — these clusters of <s>sephālikā</s> (night jasmine)!

body.text:
*{rājā}* - aho vicitratā kusumasya vasantaka (BhSv_4.2:11)
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} vasantaasaṅkittaṇeṇa ahaṃ puṇa jāṇāmi ujjaiṇīe vattāmi tti (BhSv_4.2:12)
[vasantakasaṅkīrtanenāhaṃ punar jānāmi ujjayinyāṃ varta iti | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Ah, what variety of blossoms, <s>Vasantaka</s>! *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {Aside} By the mention of <s>Vasantaka</s>, I now recognize that I am being told about [events in] <s>Ujjayinī</s>.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - vasantaka asminn evāsīnau śilātale padmāvatīṃ pratīkṣiṣyāvahe (BhSv_4.2:13)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - bho taha (BhSv_4.2:14)
  {upaviśyotthāya} hī hī saraakāḷatikkho dussaho ādavo (BhSv_4.2:15)
tā imaṃ dāva māhavīmaṇḍavaṃ pavisāmo (BhSv_4.2:16)
[bhos tathā | hī hī śaratkālatīkṣṇo dussaha ātapaḥ | tad imaṃ tāvan mādhavīmaṇḍapaṃ praviśāvaḥ | ]
