body.translated_text: *{King}* — <s>Vasantaka</s>, let us sit right here on this stone slab and await <s>Padmāvatī</s>. *{Jester}* — Very well, sir. {Having sat down and then rising} Ha, ha!

body.text:
*{rājā}* - bāḍham (BhSv_4.2:17)
gacchāgrataḥ (BhSv_4.2:18)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - evvaṃ hodu (BhSv_4.2:19)
[evaṃ bhavatu | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Indeed. Go ahead. *{Jester}* — Let it be so.

body.text:
{ubhau parikrāmataḥ (BhSv_4.2:20)}
*{padmāvatī}* - savvaṃ āuḷaṃ kattukāmo ayyavasantao (BhSv_4.2:21)
kiṃ dāṇiṃ karehma (BhSv_4.2:22)
[sarvam ākulaṃ kartukāma āryavasantakaḥ | kim idānīṃ kurmaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: {Both walk about.} *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — The noble <s>Vasantaka</s> wants to make everything confused! What shall we do now?

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie edaṃ mahuarapariṇiḷīṇaṃ oḷaṃbaḷadaṃ odhūya bhaṭṭāraṃ vāraissaṃ (BhSv_4.2:23)
[bhartṛdārike etāṃ madhukaraparinilīnām avalambalatām avadhūya bhartāraṃ vārayiṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Noble princess, I shall shake this hanging creeper where bees have settled and ward off the lord.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - evvaṃ karehi (BhSv_4.2:24)
[evaṃ kuru | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Do so.
{The maid does so.} *{Jester}* — Ahh! Ahh! Wait, wait a moment, sir!

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kim artham (BhSv_4.2:27)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - dāsīeputtehi mahuarehi pīḍido hmi (BhSv_4.2:28)
[dāsyāḥ putrair madhukaraiḥ pīḍito 'smi | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — For what reason? *{Jester}* — I am being tormented by these bees, the sons of slave-women!

body.text:
*{rājā}* - mā mā bhavān evam (BhSv_4.2:29)
madhukarasantrāsaḥ parihāryaḥ (BhSv_4.2:30)
paśya
body.translated_text: *{King}* — No, no, sir, do not speak so! One should not be alarmed by bees. Behold —

body.text: madhumadakalā madhukarā madanārtābhiḥ priyābhir upagūḍhāḥ &

children.text: pādanyāsaviṣaṇṇā vayam iva kāntāviyuktāḥ syuḥ // BhSv_4.3 //
children.translated_text: Dejected by the settling of their steps — they would be like us, separated from our beloved! (4.3)

body.translated_text: The bees, humming with the intoxication of honey, embraced by their beloved mates who are maddened with passion,

body.text:
tasmād ihaivāsiṣyāvahe (BhSv_4.3:1)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - evvaṃ hodu (BhSv_4.3:2)
[evaṃ bhavatu | ]
body.translated_text: Therefore let us sit right here. *{Jester}* — Let it be so.
{Both sit down.} *{King}* — {Looking around}

body.text: pādākrāntāni puṣpāṇi soṣma cedaṃ śilātalam &

children.text: nūnaṃ kācidihāsīnā māṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā gatā // BhSv_4.4 //
children.translated_text: Surely someone was sitting here and, upon seeing me, departed in haste. (4.4)

body.translated_text: These flowers trampled underfoot, and this stone slab still warm —

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie ruddhā khu hma vayaṃ (BhSv_4.4:1)
[bhartṛdārike ruddhāḥ khalu smo vayam | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Noble princess, we are indeed trapped!

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - diṭṭhiā uvaviṭṭho ayyautto (BhSv_4.4:2)
[diṣṭyopaviṣṭa āryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Fortunately the noble prince has sat down.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} diṭṭhiā pakiditthasarīro ayyautto (BhSv_4.4:3)
[diṣṭyā prakṛtisthaśarīra āryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {Aside} Fortunately the noble prince is in good health.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie sassupādā khu ayyāe diṭṭhī (BhSv_4.4:4)
[bhartṛdārike sāśrupātā khalv āryāyā dṛṣṭiḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Noble princess, the noble lady's gaze is indeed full of tears.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - esā khu mahuarāṇaṃ aviṇaādo kāsakusumareṇuṇā paḍideṇa sodaā me diṭṭhī (BhSv_4.4:5)
[eṣā khalu madhukarāṇām avinayāt kāśakusumareṇunā patitena sodakā me dṛṣṭiḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — This is indeed from the impudence of the bees — my eyes are troubled by the pollen of the <s>kāśa</s> grass flowers that fell [upon me].

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - jujjai (BhSv_4.4:6)
[yujyate | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — That is fitting.

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - bho suṇṇaṃ khu idaṃ pamadavaṇaṃ (BhSv_4.4:7)
pucchidavvaṃ kiñci atthi (BhSv_4.4:8)
pucchāmi bhavantaṃ (BhSv_4.4:9)
[bhoḥ śūnyaṃ khalv idaṃ pramadavanam | praṣṭavyaṃ kiñcid asti | pṛcchāmi bhavantam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester (<s>Vidūṣaka</s>)}* — Well, this pleasure-garden is deserted. I have something to ask. I shall ask you.
[Well, this pleasure-garden is deserted. I have something to ask. I shall ask you.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - chandataḥ (BhSv_4.4:10)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kā bhavado piā tadāṇiṃ tattahodī vāsavadattā idāṇiṃ padumāvadī vā (BhSv_4.4:11)
[kā bhavataḥ priyā tadānīṃ tatrabhavatī vāsavadattā idānīṃ padmāvatī vā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — As you wish.
*{Jester}* — Who is dearer to you — the former lady <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, or the present <s>Padmāvatī</s>?
[Who is dearer to you — the former lady <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, or the present <s>Padmāvatī</s>?]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kim idānīṃ bhavān mahati bahumānasaṅkaṭe māṃ nyasyati (BhSv_4.4:12)
*{padmāvatī}* - haḷā jādise saṅkaṭe nikkhitto ayyautto (BhSv_4.4:13)
[haḷā yādṛśe saṅkaṭe nikṣipta āryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Why does the gentleman now place me in such a great dilemma of respect?
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Dear friend, what a dilemma the noble lord has been placed in!
[Dear friend, what a dilemma the noble lord has been placed in!]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} ahaṃ a mandabhāā (BhSv_4.4:14)
[ahaṃ ca mandabhāgā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} And I am the ill-fated one.
[And I am the ill-fated one.]

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - seraṃ seraṃ bhaṇādu bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.4:15)
ekkā uvaradā avarā asaṇṇihidā (BhSv_4.4:16)
[svairaṃ svairaṃ bhaṇatu bhavān | ekoparatā aparā asannihitā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester}* — Let the master speak softly, softly. One [wife] has withdrawn, the other is not present.
[Let the master speak softly, softly. One has withdrawn, the other is not present.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - vayasya na khalu na khalu brūyām (BhSv_4.4:17)
bhavāṃs tu mukharaḥ (BhSv_4.4:18)
*{padmāvatī}* - ettaeṇa bhaṇidaṃ ayyautteṇa (BhSv_4.4:19)
[etāvatā bhaṇitam āryaputreṇa | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Friend, I should certainly not say! But you are a chatterbox.
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — By this much, the noble lord has already spoken.
[By this much, the noble lord has already spoken.]

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - bho sacceṇa savāmi kassa vi ṇa ācakkhissaṃ (BhSv_4.4:20)
esā sandaṭṭhā me jīhā (BhSv_4.4:21)
[bhoḥ satyeṇa śapāmi kasmā api nākhyāsye | eṣā sandaṣṭā me jihvā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester}* — Sir, I swear in truth — I shall not tell anyone! See, I have bitten my tongue [as an oath]!
[Sir, I swear in truth — I shall not tell anyone! See, I have bitten my tongue!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - notsahe sakhe vaktum (BhSv_4.4:22)
*{padmāvatī}* - aho imassa purobhāidā (BhSv_4.4:23)
ettieṇa hiaaṃ ṇa jāṇādi (BhSv_4.4:24)
[aho asya purobhāgitā | etāvatā hṛdayaṃ na jānāti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — I cannot bring myself to speak, friend.
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Ah, his partiality! He does not know his own heart even with this much.
[Ah, his partiality! He does not know his own heart even with this much.]

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kiṃ ṇa bhaṇādi mama (BhSv_4.4:25)
aṇācakkhia imādo siḷāvaṭṭaādo ṇa sakkaṃ ekkapadaṃ vi gamiduṃ (BhSv_4.4:26)
eso ruddho attabhavaṃ (BhSv_4.4:27)
[kiṃ na bhaṇati mama | anākhyāyāsmāc chilāpaṭṭakān na śakyam ekapadam api gantum | eṣa ruddho 'trabhavān | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester}* — Why won't he tell me? Without telling, it is not possible to take even a single step from this stone slab. The master is blocked!
[Why won't he tell me? Without telling, it is not possible to take even a single step from this stone slab. The master is blocked!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kiṃ balātkāreṇa (BhSv_4.4:28)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - āma baḷakkāreṇa (BhSv_4.4:29)
[āma balātkāreṇa | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Is this by force?
*{Jester}* — Yes, by force!
[Yes, by force!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - tena hi paśyāmas tāvat (BhSv_4.4:30)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - pasīdadu pasīdadu bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.4:31)
vaassabhāveṇa sāvido si jai saccaṃ ṇa bhaṇāsi (BhSv_4.4:32)
[prasīdatu prasīdatu bhavān | vayasyabhāvena śāpito 'si yadi satyaṃ na bhaṇasi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Very well then, let us see.
*{Jester}* — Please, please, sir! By the bond of friendship I adjure you — if you do not speak the truth!
[Please, please, sir! By the bond of friendship I adjure you — if you do not speak the truth!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kā gatiḥ (BhSv_4.4:33)
śrūyatām (BhSv_4.4:34)
body.translated_text: *{King}* — What choice do I have? Listen —

body.text: padmāvatī bahumatā mama yady api rūpaśīlamādhuryaiḥ &

children.text: vāsavadattābaddhaṃ na tu tāvan me mano harati // BhSv_4.5 //
children.translated_text: still, my heart, bound to <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, she cannot yet steal away. // BhSv_4.5 //

body.translated_text: Though <s>Padmāvatī</s> is greatly esteemed by me for her beauty, character, and sweetness,

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} bhodu bhodu (BhSv_4.5:1)
diṇṇaṃ vedaṇaṃ imassa parikhedassa (BhSv_4.5:2)
aho aññādavāsaṃ pi ettha bahuguṇaṃ sampajjai (BhSv_4.5:3)
[bhavatu bhavatu | dattaṃ vetanam asya parikhedasya | aho ajñātavāso 'py atra bahuguṇaḥ sampadyate | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} Very well, very well! The reward for this suffering has been given. Ah, even living in disguise proves to be richly rewarding here!
[Very well, very well! The reward for this suffering has been given. Ah, even living in disguise proves richly rewarding here!]

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - bhaṭṭidārie adakkhiñño khu bhaṭṭā (BhSv_4.5:4)
[bhartṛdārike adākṣiṇyaḥ khalu bhartā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Maidservant}* — Princess, the master is indeed ungracious.
[Princess, the master is indeed ungracious.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - haḷā mā mā evvaṃ (BhSv_4.5:5)
sadakkhiñño evva ayyautto jo idāṇiṃ vi ayyāe guṇāṇi sumaradi (BhSv_4.5:6)
[halā mā maivam | sadākṣiṇya evāryaputraḥ ya idānīm apy āryāyā vāsavadattāyā guṇān smarati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Dear friend, do not say so! The noble lord is indeed gracious, for even now he remembers the virtues of the noble lady <s>Vāsavadattā</s>.
[Dear friend, do not say so! The noble lord is indeed gracious, for even now he remembers the virtues of the noble lady <s>Vāsavadattā</s>.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - bhadde abhijaṇassa sadisaṃ mantidaṃ (BhSv_4.5:7)
[bhadre abhijanasya sadṛśaṃ mantritam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Dear one, what is spoken is worthy of your noble birth.
[Dear one, what is spoken is worthy of your noble birth.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - uktaṃ mayā (BhSv_4.5:8)
bhavān idānīṃ kathayatu (BhSv_4.5:9)
kā bhavataḥ priyā tadā vāsavadattā idānīṃ padmāvatī vā (BhSv_4.5:10)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyautto pi vasantao saṃvutto (BhSv_4.5:11)
[āryaputro 'pi vasantakaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — I have spoken. Now let the gentleman tell. Who is dearer to you — <s>Vāsavadattā</s> then, or <s>Padmāvatī</s> now?
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — The noble lord has also become a <s>Vasantaka</s> [a trickster]!
[The noble lord has also become a <s>Vasantaka</s>!]

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kiṃ me vippaḷavideṇa (BhSv_4.5:12)
ubhao vi tattahodīo me bahumadāo (BhSv_4.5:13)
[kiṃ me vipralapitena | ubhe api tatrabhavatyau me bahumate | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester}* — What use is my prattling? Both these noble ladies are greatly esteemed by me.
[What use is my prattling? Both these noble ladies are greatly esteemed by me.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - vaidheya mām evaṃ balāc chrutvā kim idānīṃ nābhibhāṣase (BhSv_4.5:14)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kiṃ maṃ pi baḷakkāreṇa (BhSv_4.5:15)
[kiṃ mām api balātkāreṇa | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Rascal! Having forced me to listen like this, why will you not speak now?
*{Jester}* — Am I too to be forced?
[Am I too to be forced?]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - athakiṃ balātkāreṇa (BhSv_4.5:16)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - teṇa hi ṇa sakkaṃ soduṃ (BhSv_4.5:17)
[tena hi na śakyaṃ śrotum | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Indeed, by force!
*{Jester}* — Well then, you cannot [make me] listen!
[Well then, you cannot make me listen!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - prasīdatu prasīdatu mahābrāhmaṇaḥ (BhSv_4.5:18)
svairaṃ svairam abhidhīyatām (BhSv_4.5:19)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - idāṇiṃ suṇādu bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.5:20)
tattahodī vāsavadattā me bahumadā (BhSv_4.5:21)
tattahodī padumāvadī taruṇī dassaṇīā akovaṇā aṇahaṅkārā mahuravāā sadakkhiññā (BhSv_4.5:22)
aaṃ ca avaro mahanto guṇo siṇiddheṇa bhoaṇeṇa maṃ paccuggacchai vāsavadattā kahiṃṇukhu gado ayyavasantao tti (BhSv_4.5:23)
[idānīṃ śṛṇotu bhavān | tatrabhavatī vāsavadattā me bahumatā | tatrabhavatī padmāvatī taruṇī darśanīyā akopanā anahaṅkārā madhuravāk sadākṣiṇyā | ayaṃ cāparo mahān guṇaḥ snigdhena bhojanena māṃ pratyudgacchati vāsavadattā kutra nu khalu gata āryavasantaka iti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Please, please, great <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>! Speak freely, freely.
*{Jester}* — Then let the master listen now. The noble lady <s>Vāsavadattā</s> is greatly esteemed by me. The noble lady <s>Padmāvatī</s> is young, beautiful, free from anger, without pride, sweet-spoken, and gracious. And this is another great virtue — she greets me with delicious food, [saying] 'Where has the noble <s>Vasantaka</s> gone, <s>Vāsavadattā</s>?'
[Then listen. The noble <s>Vāsavadattā</s> is esteemed by me. <s>Padmāvatī</s> is young, beautiful, free from anger, without pride, sweet-spoken, and gracious. This is another great virtue — she greets me with delicious food, asking 'Where has the noble <s>Vasantaka</s> gone?']

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* - bhodu bhodu vasantaa sumarehi dāṇiṃ edaṃ (BhSv_4.5:24)
[bhavatu bhavatu vasantaka smaredānīm etām | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Very well, very well, <s>Vasantaka</s> — remember this now!
[Very well, very well, <s>Vasantaka</s> — remember this now!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - bhavatu bhavatu vasantaka sarvam etat kathayiṣye devyai vāsavadattāyai (BhSv_4.5:25)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - avihā vāsavadattā (BhSv_4.5:26)
kahiṃ vāsavadattā (BhSv_4.5:27)
cirā khu uvaradā vāsavadattā (BhSv_4.5:28)
[avihā vāsavadattā | kutra vāsavadattā | cirāt khalūparatā vāsavadattā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Very well, very well, <s>Vasantaka</s> — I shall report all of this to Queen <s>Vāsavadattā</s>!
*{Jester}* — Alas, <s>Vāsavadattā</s>! Where is <s>Vāsavadattā</s>? <s>Vāsavadattā</s> passed away long ago!
[Alas, <s>Vāsavadattā</s>! Where is <s>Vāsavadattā</s>? <s>Vāsavadattā</s> passed away long ago!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* -
  {saviṣādam} evam (BhSv_4.5:29)
uparatā vāsavadattā (BhSv_4.5:30)
body.translated_text:
*{King}* —
  {With sorrow:} Indeed. <s>Vāsavadattā</s> has passed away.

body.text: anena parihāsena vyākṣiptaṃ me manas tvayā &

children.text: tato vāṇī tathaiveyaṃ pūrvābhyāsena nissṛtā // BhSv_4.6 //
children.translated_text: and so this speech has escaped me, by force of old habit. // BhSv_4.6 //

body.translated_text: By this jest, my mind has been shaken by you;

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ramaṇīo khu kahājoo ṇisaṃseṇa visaṃvādio (BhSv_4.6:1)
[ramaṇīyaḥ khalu kathāyogo nṛśaṃsena visaṃvāditaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — The charming conversation was spoiled by a cruel one.
[The charming conversation was spoiled by a cruel one.]

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {ātmagatam} bhodu bhodu vissatthahmi (BhSv_4.6:2)
aho piaṃ ṇāma īdisaṃ vaaṇaṃ appaccakkhaṃ suṇīadi (BhSv_4.6:3)
[bhavatu bhavatu viśvastāsmi | aho priyaṃ nāmedṛśaṃ vacanam apratyakṣaṃ śrūyate | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* —
  {Aside:} Very well, very well — I am reassured! Ah, how sweet it is to hear such words spoken in one's absence!
[Very well, very well — I am reassured! How sweet it is to hear such words spoken in one's absence!]

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - dhāredu dhāredu bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.6:4)
aṇadikkamaṇīo hi vihī (BhSv_4.6:5)
īdisaṃ dāṇi edaṃ (BhSv_4.6:6)
[dhārayatu dhārayatu bhavān | anatikramaṇīyo hi vidhiḥ | īdṛśam idānīm etad | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester}* — Hold on, hold on, sir! Fate cannot be transgressed. Such is the way of things now.
[Hold on, hold on, sir! Fate cannot be transgressed. Such is the way of things now.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - vayasya na jānāti bhavān avasthām (BhSv_4.6:7)
kutaḥ
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Friend, you do not understand my condition. How so —

body.text: duḥkhaṃ tyaktuṃ baddhamūlo 'nurāgaḥ smṛtvā smṛtvā yāti duḥkhaṃ navatvam &

children.text: yātrā tv eṣā yad vimucyeha bāṣpaṃ prāptānṛṇyā yāti buddhiḥ prasādam // BhSv_4.7 //
children.translated_text: yet this is the journey — that by shedding tears here, the heart, having discharged its debt [of love], attains peace. // BhSv_4.7 //

body.translated_text: It is difficult to abandon love once it has taken root; remembering again and again, the grief becomes fresh;

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - assupādakiḷiṇṇaṃ khu tattahodo muhaṃ (BhSv_4.7:1)
jāva muhodaaṃ āṇemi (BhSv_4.7:2)
[aśrupātaklinnaṃ khalu tatrabhavato mukham | yāvan mukhodakam ānayāmi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester}* — The master's face is wet with falling tears. Let me fetch water for [washing] his face.
[The master's face is wet with falling tears. Let me fetch water for his face.]

body.text:
{niṣkrāntaḥ (BhSv_4.7:3)}
*{padmāvatī}* - ayye bapphāuḷapaḍantaridaṃ ayyauttassa muhaṃ (BhSv_4.7:4)
jāva ṇikkamahma (BhSv_4.7:5)
[ārye bāṣpākulapaṭāntaritam āryaputrasya mukham | yāvan niṣkrāmāmaḥ | ]

*{vāsavadattā}* - evvaṃ hodu (BhSv_4.7:6)
ahava ciṭṭha tuvaṃ (BhSv_4.7:7)
ukkaṇṭhidaṃ bhattāraṃ ujjhia ajuttaṃ ṇiggamaṇaṃ (BhSv_4.7:8)
ahaṃ evva gamissaṃ (BhSv_4.7:9)
[evaṃ bhavatu | athavā tiṣṭha tvam | utkaṇṭhitaṃ bhartāram ujjhitvāyuktaṃ nirgamanam | aham eva gamiṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Let it be so. Or rather, you stay — it is improper to go out leaving the lord who is longing. I myself shall go.

body.text:
*{ceṭī}* - suṭṭhu ayyā bhaṇādi (BhSv_4.7:10)
uvasappadu dāva bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_4.7:11)
[suṣṭhv āryā bhaṇati | upasarpatu tāvad bhartṛdārikā | ]
body.translated_text: *{Maid}* — Well spoken, my lady. Let the princess approach.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - kiṃṇukhu pavisāmi (BhSv_4.7:12)
[kin nu khalu praviśāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Shall I indeed enter?
*{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Dear friend, enter. {Having said this, she exits.}

body.text:
{praviśya}
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* -
  {nalinīpatreṇa jalaṃ gṛhītvā} esā tattahodī padumāvadī (BhSv_4.7:15)
[eṣā tatrabhavatī padmāvatī | ]
body.translated_text: {Entering} *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — {taking water with a lotus leaf} Here is the noble lady <s>Padmāvatī</s>.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayya vasantaa kiṃ edaṃ (BhSv_4.7:16)
[ārya vasantaka kim etat | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble <s>Vasantaka</s>, what is this?

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - edaṃ idaṃ (BhSv_4.7:17)
idaṃ edaṃ (BhSv_4.7:18)
[etad idam | idam etat | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — This is this. This is this.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - bhaṇādu bhaṇādu ayyo bhaṇādu (BhSv_4.7:19)
[bhaṇatu bhaṇatv āryo bhaṇatu | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Speak! Speak! Let the noble one speak!

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - bhodi vādaṇīdeṇa kāsakusumareṇuṇā akkhiṇipaḍideṇa sassupādaṃ khu tattahodo muhaṃ (BhSv_4.7:20)
tā gahṇadu hodī idaṃ muhodaaṃ (BhSv_4.7:21)
[bhavati vātanītena kāśakusumareṇunākṣinipatitena sāśrupātaṃ khalu tatrabhavato mukham | tad gṛhṇātu bhavatīdaṃ mukhodakam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — My lady, <s>kāśa</s>-flower pollen carried by the wind has fallen into [the king's] eyes, so the noble one's face is tearful. Therefore, my lady, please take this face-water.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* -
  {ātmagatam} aho sadakkhiññassa jaṇassa parijaṇo vi sadakkhiñño evva hodi (BhSv_4.7:22)
  {upetya} jedu ayyautto (BhSv_4.7:23)
idaṃ muhodaaṃ (BhSv_4.7:24)
[aho sadākṣiṇyasya janasya parijano 'pi sadākṣiṇya eva bhavati | jayatv āryaputraḥ | idaṃ mukhodakam | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — {to herself} Ah, the attendants of a gracious person are themselves gracious indeed. {approaching} Victory to the noble prince! Here is face-water.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - aye padmāvatī (BhSv_4.7:25)
  {apavārya} vasantaka kim idam (BhSv_4.7:26)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* -
  {karṇe} evvaṃ via (BhSv_4.7:27)
[evam iva | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Oh, <s>Padmāvatī</s>. {aside} <s>Vasantaka</s>, what is this? *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — {whispering in his ear} It is like this.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - sādhu vasantaka sādhu (BhSv_4.7:28)
  {ācamya} padmāvati āsyatām (BhSv_4.7:29)
*{padmāvatī}* - jaṃ ayyautto āṇavedi (BhSv_4.7:30)
[yad āryaputra ājñāpayati | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Well done, <s>Vasantaka</s>, well done! {having rinsed his face} <s>Padmāvatī</s>, be seated. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — As the noble prince commands.

body.text:
{upaviśati (BhSv_4.7:31)}
*{rājā}* - padmāvati
body.translated_text: {She sits.} *{King}* — <s>Padmāvatī</s>,

body.text: śaracchaśāṅkagaureṇa vātāviddhena bhāmini &

children.text: kāśapuṣpalavenedaṃ sāśrupātaṃ mukhaṃ mama // BhSv_4.8 //
children.translated_text: by a wisp of <s>kāśa</s> flower — this face of mine is [rendered] tearful. // <s>BhSv</s>_4.8 //

body.translated_text: By [the complexion] fair as the autumn moon, and by wind-blown,

body.text: {ātmagatam}
body.translated_text: {To himself:}

body.text: iyaṃ bālā navodvāhā satyaṃ śrutvā vyathāṃ vrajet &

children.text: kāmaṃ dhīrasvabhāveyaṃ strīsvabhāvas tu kātaraḥ // BhSv_4.9 //
children.translated_text: Though she is of steadfast nature, the nature of a woman is timid. // <s>BhSv</s>_4.9 //

body.translated_text: This young bride is newly wed; hearing the truth, she would be distressed.

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - uidaṃ tattahodo maadharāassa avarahṇakāḷe bhavantaṃ aggado karia suhijjaṇadaṃsaṇaṃ (BhSv_4.9:1)
sakkāro hi ṇāma sakkāreṇa paḍicchido pīdiṃ uppādedi (BhSv_4.9:2)
tā uṭṭhedu dāva bhavaṃ (BhSv_4.9:3)
[ucitaṃ tatrabhavato magadharājasyāparāhṇakāle bhavantam agrataḥ kṛtvā suhṛjjanadarśanam | satkāro hi nāma satkāreṇa pratīṣṭaḥ prītim utpādayati | tad uttiṣṭhatu tāvad bhavān | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — It is fitting that the noble <s>Magadha</s> king, in the afternoon, should place your honor at the forefront for the meeting with friends. For hospitality reciprocated with hospitality produces delight. Therefore, let your honor rise.
*{King}* — Very well. This is the proper course of action. {Rising.}

body.text: guṇānāṃ vā viśālānāṃ satkārāṇāṃ ca nityaśaḥ &

children.text: kartāraḥ sulabhā loke vijñātāras tu durlabhāḥ // BhSv_4.10 //
children.translated_text: acts of courtesy — such doers are easily found in the world; but those who appreciate [them] are rare. // <s>BhSv</s>_4.10 //

body.translated_text: Of those who possess great virtues and constantly perform

body.text: {niṣkrāntāḥ sarve (1)} caturtho 'ṅkaḥ |
body.translated_text: {All exit.} End of the Fourth Act.

body.text:
atha pañcamo 'ṅkaḥ |
  {tataḥ praviśati padminikā (BhSv_5.0:1)}
*{padminikā}* - mahuarie mahuarie āaccha dāva sigghaṃ (BhSv_5.0:2)
[madhukarike madhukarike āgaccha tāvac chīghram | ]
body.translated_text: Now the Fifth Act. {Then <s>Padminikā</s> enters.} *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — <s>Madhukarikā</s>! <s>Madhukarikā</s>! Come here quickly!

body.text:
{praviśya (BhSv_5.0:3)}
*{madhukarikā}* - haḷā ia hmi (BhSv_5.0:4)
kiṃ karīadu (BhSv_5.0:5)
[haḷā iyam asmi | kiṃ kriyatām | ]
body.translated_text: {Entering.} *{<s>Madhukarikā</s>}* — Dear friend, here I am. What is to be done?

body.text:
*{padminikā}* - haḷā kiṃ ṇa jāṇāsi tuvaṃ bhaṭṭidāriā padumāvadī sīsavedaṇāe dukkhāvide tti (BhSv_5.0:6)
[haḷā kiṃ na jānāsi tvaṃ bhartṛdārikā padmāvatī śīrṣavedanayā duḥkhiteti | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — Friend, don't you know? The princess <s>Padmāvatī</s> is suffering from a headache.

body.text:
*{madhukarikā}* - haddhi (BhSv_5.0:7)
[hā dhik | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Madhukarikā</s>}* — Oh no!

body.text:
*{padminikā}* - haḷā gaccha sigghaṃ ayyaṃ āvantiaṃ saddāvehi (BhSv_5.0:8)
kevaḷaṃ bhaṭṭidāriāe sīsavedaṇaṃ evva ṇivedehi (BhSv_5.0:9)
tado saaṃ evva āgamissadi (BhSv_5.0:10)
[haḷā gaccha śīghram āryām āvantikāṃ śabdāpaya | kevalaṃ bhartṛdārikāyāḥ śīrṣavedanām eva nivedaya | tataḥ svayam evāgamiṣyati | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — Friend, go quickly and summon the lady <s>Āvantikā</s>. Only tell her about the princess's headache. Then she will come of her own accord.

body.text:
*{madhukarikā}* - haḷā kiṃ sā karissadi (BhSv_5.0:11)
[haḷā kiṃ sā kariṣyati | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Madhukarikā</s>}* — Friend, what will she do?

body.text:
*{padminikā}* - sā hu dāṇiṃ mahurāhi kahāhi bhaṭṭidāriāe sīsavedaṇaṃ viṇodedi (BhSv_5.0:12)
[sā khalv idānīṃ madhurābhiḥ kathābhir bhartṛdārikāyāḥ śīrṣavedanāṃ vinodayati | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — She, you know, dispels the princess's headache with sweet stories.

body.text:
*{madhukarikā}* - jujjai (BhSv_5.0:13)
kahiṃ saaṇīyaṃ raidaṃ bhaṭṭidāriāe (BhSv_5.0:14)
[yujyate | kutra śayanīyaṃ racitaṃ bhartṛdārikāyāḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Madhukarikā</s>}* — That's right. Where has the princess's bed been prepared?

body.text:
*{padminikā}* - samuddagihake kiḷa sejjātthiṇṇā (BhSv_5.0:15)
gacchadāṇi tuvaṃ (BhSv_5.0:16)
ahaṃ vi bhaṭṭiṇo ṇivedaṇatthaṃ ayyavasantaaṃ aṇṇesāmi (BhSv_5.0:17)
[samudragṛhake kila śayyāstīrṇā | gacchedānīṃ tvam | ahamapi bhartre nivedanārtham āryavasantakam anviṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — In the Ocean-house, they say, the bed is spread. Go now. I too shall look for the noble <s>Vasantaka</s> in order to inform the lord.

body.text:
*{madhukarikā}* - evvaṃ hodu (BhSv_5.0:18)
[evaṃ bhavatu | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Madhukarikā</s>}* — So be it.
{She exits.} *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — Where shall I find the noble <s>Vasantaka</s> now?

{Then the <s>Vidūṣaka</s> enters.} *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — Today indeed, at this supremely auspicious festival — the marriage of the noble <s>Vatsarāja</s> to <s>Padmāvatī</s> — while his heart is distressed by separation from the queen, the fire of love burns all the more. {Seeing <s>Padminikā</s>.} Oh, <s>Padminikā</s>! <s>Padminikā</s>, what is happening here?

body.text:
*{padminikā}* - ayya vasantaa kiṃ ṇa jāṇāsi tuvaṃ bhaṭṭidāriā padumāvadī sīsavedaṇāe duḥkhāvidetti (BhSv_5.0:26)
[ārya vasantaka kiṃ na jānāsi tvaṃ bhartṛdārikā padmāvatī śīrṣavedanayā duḥkhiteti | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — Noble <s>Vasantaka</s>, don't you know? The princess <s>Padmāvatī</s> is suffering from a headache.

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - bhodi saccaṃ ṇa jāṇāmi (BhSv_5.0:27)
[bhavati satyaṃ na jānāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — My lady, truly I did not know.

body.text:
*{padminikā}* - teṇa hi bhaṭṭiṇo ṇivedehi ṇaṃ (BhSv_5.0:28)
jāva ahaṃ vi sīsāṇuḷevaṇaṃ tuvāremi (BhSv_5.0:29)
[tena hi bhartre nivedayainām | yāvad aham api śīrṣānulepanaṃ tvarayāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — Then inform the lord about her. Meanwhile, I too shall hurry with the head-ointment.

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kahiṃ saaṇīaṃ raidaṃ padumāvadīe (BhSv_5.0:30)
[kutra śayanīyaṃ racitaṃ padmāvatyāḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — Where has <s>Padmāvatī</s>'s bed been prepared?

body.text:
*{padminikā}* - samuddagihake kiḷa sayyattiṇṇā (BhSv_5.0:31)
[samudragṛhake kila śayyāstīrṇā | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padminikā</s>}* — In the Ocean-house, they say, the bed is spread.

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - gacchadu bhodī (BhSv_5.0:32)
jāva ahaṃ vi tattahodo ṇivedaissaṃ (BhSv_5.0:33)
[gacchatu bhavatī | yāvad aham api tatrabhavate nivedayiṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vidūṣaka</s>}* — Let my lady go. I too shall inform the noble one.
{Both exit.} Interlude. {Then the King enters.} *{King}* —

body.text: ślāghyām avantinṛpateḥ sadṛśīṃ tanūjāṃ kālakrameṇa punar āgatadārabhāraḥ &

children.text: lāvāṇake hutavahena hṛtāṅgayaṣṭiṃ tāṃ padminīṃ himahatām iva cintayāmi // BhSv_5.1 //
children.translated_text: Yet I think of her, <s>Padminī</s>, whose body was consumed by fire at <s>Lāvāṇaka</s>, like a lotus struck by frost. // BhSv_5.1 //

body.translated_text: The praiseworthy daughter of the king of <s>Avantī</s>, a fitting match — in time I bore the burden of marriage once again;

{Entering.} *{Jester}* — Hurry, hurry, sir!
[Hurry, hurry, sir!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kimartham (BhSv_5.1:3)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - tattahodī padumāvadī sīsavedaṇāe dukkhāvidā (BhSv_5.1:4)
[tatrabhavatī padmāvatī śīrṣavedanayā duḥkhitā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — For what reason?
*{Jester}* — The venerable <s>Padmāvatī</s> is afflicted with a headache.
[The venerable <s>Padmāvatī</s> is afflicted with a headache.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kaivam āha (BhSv_5.1:5)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - padumiṇiāe kahidaṃ (BhSv_5.1:6)
[padminikayā kathitam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Who says so?
*{Jester}* — <s>Padminikā</s> told me.
[<s>Padminikā</s> told me.]

body.text: *{rājā}* - bhoḥ kaṣṭaṃ
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Alas, how distressing!

body.text: rūpaśriyā samuditāṃ guṇataś ca yuktāṃ labdhvā priyāṃ mama tu manda ivādya śokaḥ &

children.text: pūrvābhighātasarujo 'py anubhūtaduḥkhaḥ padmāvatīm api tathaiva samarthayāmi // BhSv_5.2 //
children.translated_text: Still aches from a former blow, having endured that suffering; I regard <s>Padmāvatī</s> in just the same way. // BhSv_5.2 //

body.translated_text: Having obtained a beloved who is endowed with beauty and grace, and possessed of virtues — yet, fool that I am, my grief today

body.text:
atha kasmin pradeśe vartate padmāvatī (BhSv_5.2:1)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - samuddagihake kiḷa sejjātthiṇṇā (BhSv_5.2:2)
[samudragṛhake kila śayyāstīrṇā | ]
body.translated_text:
Now, in which part [of the palace] is <s>Padmāvatī</s>?
*{Jester}* — She is said to have her bed laid out in the Ocean Pavilion.
[She is said to have her bed laid out in the Ocean Pavilion.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - tena hi tasya mārgam ādeśaya (BhSv_5.2:3)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - edu edu bhavaṃ (BhSv_5.2:4)
[etv etu bhavān | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Then show me the way there.
*{Jester}* — Come, come, sir!
[Come, come, sir!]

body.text:
{ubhau parikrāmataḥ (BhSv_5.2:5)}
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - idaṃ samuddagihakaṃ (BhSv_5.2:6)
pavisadu bhavaṃ (BhSv_5.2:7)
[idaṃ samudragṛhakam | praviśatu bhavān | ]
body.translated_text:
{Both walk about.}
*{Jester}* — Here is the Ocean Pavilion.
Let sir enter.
[Here is the Ocean Pavilion. Let sir enter.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - pūrvaṃ praviśa (BhSv_5.2:8)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - bho taha (BhSv_5.2:9)
  {praviśya} avihā ciṭṭhadu ciṭṭhadu dāva bhavaṃ (BhSv_5.2:10)
[bhoḥ tathā | avihā tiṣṭhatu tiṣṭhatu tāvad bhavān | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — You enter first.
*{Jester}* — Very well.
  {Entering} Wait, wait, sir! Stay where you are!
[Very well. Wait, wait, sir! Stay where you are!]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kimartham (BhSv_5.2:11)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - eso khu dīvappabhāvasūidarūvo vasudhātaḷe parivattamāṇo aaṃ kāodaro (BhSv_5.2:12)
[eṣa khalu dīpaprabhāvasūcitarūpo vasudhātale parivartamāno 'yaṃ kākodaraḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — For what reason?
*{Jester}* — Here on the floor, its form revealed by the lamplight, rolling about — it is a cobra!
[Here on the floor, its form revealed by the lamplight, rolling about — it is a cobra!]

body.text: ṛjvāyatāṃ hi mukhatoraṇalolamālāṃ bhraṣṭāṃ kṣitau tvam avagacchasi mūrkha sarpam &

children.text: mandānilena niśi yā parivartamānā kiñcit karoti bhujagasya viceṣṭitāni // BhSv_5.3 //
children.translated_text: Swaying in the gentle night breeze, it merely imitates the movements of a snake. // BhSv_5.3 //

body.translated_text: The garland hanging loose from the arch of the doorway, straight and extended, fallen to the ground — you, fool, mistake it for a serpent;

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* -
  {nirūpya (BhSv_5.3:1)}
suṭṭhu bhavaṃ bhaṇādi (BhSv_5.3:2)
ṇa hu aaṃ kāoaro (BhSv_5.3:3)
  {praviśyāvalokya (BhSv_5.3:4)}
tattahodī padumāvadī iha āacchia ṇiggadā bhave (BhSv_5.3:5)
[suṣṭhu bhavān bhaṇati | na khalv ayaṃ kākodaraḥ | tatrabhavatī padmāvatīhāgatya nirgatā bhavet | ]

*{rājā}* - vayasya anāgatayā bhavitavyam (BhSv_5.3:6)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - kahaṃ bhavaṃ jāṇādi (BhSv_5.3:7)
[kathaṃ bhavān jānāti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Friend, she must not have come yet.
*{Jester}* — How does sir know?
[How does sir know?]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kim atra jñeyam (BhSv_5.3:8)
paśya
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — What is there to know?
Look —

body.text: śayyā nāvanatā tathāstṛtasamā na vyākulapracchadā na kliṣṭaṃ hi śiropadhānam amalaṃ śīrṣābhighātauṣadhaiḥ &

children.text: roge dṛṣṭivilobhanaṃ janayituṃ śobhā na kācit kṛtā prāṇī prāpya rujā punar na śayanaṃ śīghraṃ svayaṃ muñcati // BhSv_5.4 //
children.translated_text: No effort at adornment has been made to create an alluring appearance in illness — a person in pain does not quickly leave the bed of their own accord. // BhSv_5.4 //

body.translated_text: The bed is not pressed down, the coverlet is spread evenly and not disarranged, the pillow is not crumpled, spotless, without any mark of head-ointments;

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - teṇa hi imassiṃ sayyāe muhuttaaṃ uvavisia tattahodiṃ paḍivāḷedu bhavaṃ (BhSv_5.4:1)
[tena hy asyāṃ śayyāyāṃ muhūrtakam upaviśya tatrabhavatīṃ pratipālayatu bhavān | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Jester}* — Then let sir sit on this bed for a moment and wait for the venerable lady.
[Then let sir sit on this bed for a moment and wait for the venerable lady.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - bāḍham (BhSv_5.4:2)
  {upaviśya (BhSv_5.4:3)}
vayasya nidrā māṃ bādhate (BhSv_5.4:4)
kathyatāṃ kācit kathā (BhSv_5.4:5)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - ahaṃ kahaissaṃ (BhSv_5.4:6)
hoṃ tti karedu attabhavaṃ (BhSv_5.4:7)
[ahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi | hoṃ iti karotv atrabhavān | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Very well.
  {Sitting down}
Friend, drowsiness overcomes me. Tell me some story.
*{Jester}* — I shall tell one. Let the noble sir say 'hm' [to show he is listening].
[I shall tell one. Let the noble sir say 'hm'.]

body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Ah, how merciless are my masters! <s>Padmāvatī</s>, who has been a place of comfort for the noble prince tormented by separation, has now fallen ill. Let me go in. {Entering and looking about} Ah, the negligence of the attendants! They leave the ailing <s>Padmāvatī</s> with only a lamp for company. Here is <s>Padmāvatī</s>, fast asleep. Let me sit down. But then, if I take another seat, it would appear that my affection is slight. So I shall sit upon this bed. {Sitting down} Why is it that, sitting beside her, my heart today feels as though gladdened? Thank heavens, her breaths of ease are uninterrupted. She must have recovered from her illness. Or rather, by sharing part of the bed, she seems to be inviting me to embrace her. Let me lie down. {She feigns sleep.}

body.translated_text: approaching that <s>Āruṇi</s>, skilled in cruel deeds, having crossed [the river] with elephants and horses,

body.translated_text: {All exit.} End of Act Five.

body.text:
atha ṣaṣṭho 'ṅkaḥ |
  {tataḥ praviśati kāñcukīyaḥ (BhSv_6.0:1)}
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - ka iha bhoḥ kañcanatoraṇadvāram aśūnyaṃ kurute (BhSv_6.0:2)
  {praviśya (BhSv_6.0:3)}
*{pratīhārī}* - ayya ahaṃ vijaā (BhSv_6.0:4)
kiṃ karīadu (BhSv_6.0:5)
[ārya ahaṃ vijayā | kiṃ kriyatām | ]
body.translated_text: Now the Sixth Act. {Then enters the Chamberlain.} *{Chamberlain}* — Who here keeps the golden gate-arch from being unattended? {He enters and sees the female doorkeeper.}

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhavati nivedyatāṃ nivedyatāṃ vatsarājyalābhapravṛddhodayāyodayanāya eṣa khalu mahāsenasya sakāśād raibhyasagotrāḥ kāñcukīyaḥ prāptaḥ tatrabhavatyā cāṅgāravatyā preṣitāryā vasundharā nāma vāsavadattādhātrī ca pratīhāram upasthitā iti (BhSv_6.0:6)
*{pratīhārī}* - ayya adesakāḷo paḍihārassa (BhSv_6.0:7)
[ārya adeśakālaḥ pratihārasya | ]
body.translated_text: *{Chamberlain}* — Good lady, please announce, announce — to <s>Udayana</s>, whose fortunes have risen with the acquisition of the <s>Vatsa</s> kingdom: this chamberlain of the <s>Raibhya</s> lineage has arrived from the presence of <s>Mahāsena</s>.

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - katham adeśakālo nāma (BhSv_6.0:8)
*{pratīhārī}* - suṇādu ayyo (BhSv_6.0:9)
ajja bhaṭṭiṇo suyyāmuhappāsādagadeṇa keṇa vi vīṇā vādidā (BhSv_6.0:10)
taṃ ca suṇia bhaṭṭiṇā bhaṇiaṃ ghosavadīe saddo via suṇīadi tti (BhSv_6.0:11)
[śṛṇotv āryaḥ | adya bhartuḥ sūryamukhaprāsādagatena kenāpi vīṇā vāditā | tāṃ ca śrutvā bhartrā bhaṇitaṃ ghoṣavatyāḥ śabda iva śrūyate iti | ]
body.translated_text: *{Chamberlain}* — What, is this an inopportune time? *{Doorkeeper}* — Let the noble sir hear. Today, someone who had ascended the moonrise terrace of the lord played a <s>vīṇā</s>.

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - tatas tataḥ (BhSv_6.0:12)
*{pratīhārī}* - tado tahiṃ gacchia pucchido kudo imāe vīṇāe āgamo tti (BhSv_6.0:13)
teṇa bhaṇiaṃ ahmehiṃ ṇammadātīre kuyyagummaḷaggā diṭṭhā (BhSv_6.0:14)
jai ppaoaṇaṃ imāe uvaṇīadu bhaṭṭiṇotti (BhSv_6.0:15)
taṃ ca uvaṇīdaṃ aṅke karia mohaṃ gado bhaṭṭā (BhSv_6.0:16)
tado mohappaccāgadeṇa bapphapayyāuḷeṇa muheṇa bhaṭṭiṇā bhaṇiaṃ diṭṭhāsi ghosavadi sā hu ṇa dissadi tti (BhSv_6.0:17)
ayya īdiso aṇavasaro (BhSv_6.0:18)
kahaṃ ṇivedemi (BhSv_6.0:19)
[tatas tatra gatvā pṛṣṭaḥ kuto 'syā vīṇāyā āgama iti | tena bhaṇitam asmābhir narmadātīre kūrcagulmalagnā dṛṣṭā | yadi prayojanam anayā upanīyatāṃ bhartre iti | tāṃ copanītām aṅke kṛṭvā mohaṃ gato bhartā | tato mohapratyāgatena bāṣpaparyākulena mukhena bhartrā bhaṇitaṃ dṛṣṭāsi ghoṣavati sā khalu na dṛśyata iti | ārya īdṛśo 'navasaraḥ | kathaṃ nivedayāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{Chamberlain}* — Then what? *{Doorkeeper}* — Then, going there, he inquired: 'Whence comes this <s>vīṇā</s>?' He said: 'We do not know.'

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhavati nivedyatām (BhSv_6.0:20)
idam api tadāśrayam eva (BhSv_6.0:21)
*{pratīhārī}* - ayya iaṃ ṇivedemi (BhSv_6.0:22)
eso bhaṭṭā suyyāmuhappāsādādo odarai (BhSv_6.0:23)
tā iha evva ṇivedaissaṃ (BhSv_6.0:24)
[ārya iyaṃ nivedayāmi | eṣa bhartā sūryāmukhaprāsādād avatarati | tad ihaiva nivedayiṣyāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{Chamberlain}* — Good lady, please announce — this matter too is connected to that very affair. *{Doorkeeper}* — Noble sir, I shall announce. Here is the lord coming from the moonrise terrace.

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - bhavati tathā (BhSv_6.0:25)
  {ubhau niṣkrāntau (BhSv_6.0:26)} miśraviṣkambhaḥ |
  {tataḥ praviśati rājā vidūṣakaśca (BhSv_6.0:27)}
*{rājā}* -
body.translated_text: *{Chamberlain}* — Good lady, very well. {Both exit.} End of the mixed interlude. {Then enter the King and the Jester.}

body.text: śrutisukhaninade kathaṃ nu devyāḥ stanayugale jaghanasthale ca suptā &

children.text: vihagagaṇarajovikīrṇadaṇḍā pratibhayam adhyuṣitāsy araṇyavāsam // BhSv_6.1 //
children.translated_text: Your rod scattered with the dust of flocks of birds — you have dwelt fearfully in the forest! (6.1)

body.translated_text: How did you sleep, O <s>vīṇā</s> whose sound is pleasing to the ear, upon the bosom and the lap of the queen?

body.text: api ca asnigdhāsi ghoṣavati yā tapasvinyā na smarasi
body.translated_text: Moreover, you are ungrateful, O <s>Ghoṣavatī</s>, in that you do not remember the ascetic woman —

body.text: śroṇīsamudvahanapārśvanipīḍitāni khedastanāntarasukhāny upagūhitāni &

children.text: uddiśya māṃ virahe paridevitāni vādyāntareṣu kathitāni ca sasmitāni // BhSv_6.2 //
children.translated_text: The lamentations addressed to me in separation, and the words spoken with a smile during musical performances. (6.2)

body.translated_text: The embraces, pleasant upon the chest, that wearied the flanks and hips that bore your weight,

body.text:
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - aḷaṃ dāṇi bhavaṃ adimattaṃ santappia (BhSv_6.2:1)
[alam idānīṃ bhavān atimātraṃ santapya | ]
body.translated_text: *{Jester}* — Enough now, sir — you are tormenting yourself excessively!

body.text: *{rājā}* - vayasya mā maivaṃ
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Friend, do not speak so —

body.text: ciraprasuptaḥ kāmo me vīṇayā pratibodhitaḥ &

children.text: tāṃ tu devīṃ na paśyāmi yasyā ghoṣavatī priyā // BhSv_6.3 //
children.translated_text: But I do not see that queen to whom <s>Ghoṣavatī</s> was dear. (6.3)

body.translated_text: My desire, long asleep, has been awakened by the <s>vīṇā</s>,

body.text:
vasantaka śilpijanasakāśān navayogāṃ ghoṣavatīṃ kṛtvā śīghram ānaya (BhSv_6.3:1)
*{vidūṣakaḥ}* - jaṃ bhavaṃ āṇavedi (BhSv_6.3:2)
  {vīṇāṃ gṛhītvā niṣkrāntaḥ (BhSv_6.3:3)}
[yad bhavān ājñāpayati | ]
body.translated_text: <s>Vasantaka</s>, have <s>Ghoṣavatī</s> fitted with new strings by the artisans and brought back quickly. *{Jester}* — As the master commands. {Taking the <s>vīṇā</s>, he exits.}

body.text:
*{pratīhārī}* - jedu bhaṭṭā (BhSv_6.3:4)
eso khu mahāseṇassa saāsādo rabbhasagotto kañcuīo devīe aṅgāravadīe pesidā ayyā vasundharā ṇāma vāsavadattādhattī a paḍihāraṃ uvaṭṭhidā (BhSv_6.3:5)
[jayatu bhartā | eṣa khalu mahāsenasya sakāśād raibhyasagotraḥ kāñcukīyo devyāṅgāravatyā preṣitāryā vasundharā nāma vāsavadattādhātrī ca pratihāram upasthitau | ]
body.translated_text: *{Doorkeeper}* — Victory to the lord! Here, a chamberlain of the <s>Raibhya</s> lineage sent from <s>Mahāsena</s>'s retinue — and the noble lady <s>Vasundharā</s> by name, a nurse of <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, sent by the queen <s>Aṅgāravatī</s> —

body.text:
*{rājā}* - tena hi padmāvatī tāvad āhūyatām (BhSv_6.3:6)
*{pratīhārī}* - jaṃ bhaṭṭā āṇavedi (BhSv_6.3:7)
  {niṣkrāntā (BhSv_6.3:8)}
[yad bhartājñāpayati | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Then let <s>Padmāvatī</s> be summoned first. *{Doorkeeper}* — As the lord commands. {She exits.}

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kin nu khalu śīghram idānīm ayaṃ vṛttānto mahāsenena viditaḥ (BhSv_6.3:9)
  {tataḥ praviśati padmāvatī pratīhārī ca (BhSv_6.3:10)}
*{pratīhārī}* - edu edu bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_6.3:11)
[etv etu bhartṛdārikā | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — How is it that <s>Mahāsena</s> has learned of these events so quickly? {Then enter <s>Padmāvatī</s> and the Doorkeeper.} *{Doorkeeper}* — Here is the noble prince.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - jedu ayyautto (BhSv_6.3:12)
[jayatv āryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Victory to the noble prince!

body.text:
*{rājā}* - padmāvati kiṃ śrutaṃ mahāsenasya sakāśād raibhyasagotraḥ kāñcukīyaḥ prāptas tatrabhavatyā cāṅgāravatyā preṣitāryā vasundharā nāma vāsavadattādhātrī ca pratihāram upasthitāv iti (BhSv_6.3:13)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyautta piaṃ me ñādikuḷassa kusaḷavuttantaṃ soduṃ (BhSv_6.3:14)
[āryaputra priyaṃ me jñātikulasya kuśalavṛttāntaṃ śrotum | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — <s>Padmāvatī</s>, have you heard? A chamberlain of the <s>Raibhya</s> lineage has arrived from <s>Mahāsena</s>, and the noble lady <s>Vasundharā</s> by name, a nurse of <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, has been sent by the revered <s>Aṅgāravatī</s>.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - anurūpam etad bhavatyābhihitaṃ vāsavadattāsvajano svajana iti (BhSv_6.3:15)
padmāvati āsyatām (BhSv_6.3:16)
kim idānīṃ nāsyate (BhSv_6.3:17)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyautta kiṃ mae saha uvaviṭṭho edaṃ jaṇaṃ pekkhissadi (BhSv_6.3:18)
[āryaputraḥ kiṃ mayā sahopaviṣṭa etaṃ janaṃ drakṣyati | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — What you have said is fitting — that <s>Vāsavadattā</s>'s people are our own people. <s>Padmāvatī</s>, be seated. Why do you not sit now?

body.text:
*{rājā}* - ko 'tra doṣaḥ (BhSv_6.3:19)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyauttassa avaro pariggaho tti udāsīṇaṃ via hodi (BhSv_6.3:20)
[āryaputrasyāparaḥ parigraha ity udāsīnam iva bhavati | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — What fault is there in that? *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — 'It is another consort of the noble prince' — one becomes as if indifferent.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kalatradarśanārhaṃ janaṃ kalatradarśanāt pariharatīti bahudoṣam utpādayati (BhSv_6.3:21)
tasmād āsyatām (BhSv_6.3:22)
*{padmāvatī}* - jaṃ ayyautto āṇavedi (BhSv_6.3:23)
  {upaviśya (BhSv_6.3:24)}
ayyautta tādo vā ambā vā kiṃṇukhu bhaṇissadi tti āviggā via saṃvuttā (BhSv_6.3:25)
[yad āryaputra ājñāpayati | āryaputra tāto vāmbā vā kin nu khalu bhaṇiṣyatīty āvigneva saṃvṛttā | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — By keeping away from the sight of a consort one who deserves to see a consort, you create many faults. Therefore, be seated. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — As the noble prince commands.

body.text: *{rājā}* - padmāvati evam etat (BhSv_6.3:26)
body.translated_text: *{King}* — <s>Padmāvatī</s>, it is so indeed —

body.text: kiṃ vakṣyatīti hṛdayaṃ pariśaṅkitaṃ me kanyā mayāpy apahṛtā na ca rakṣitā sā &

children.text: bhāgyaiś calair mahad avāptaguṇopadhātaḥ putraḥ pitur janitaroṣa ivāsmi bhītaḥ // BhSv_6.4 //
children.translated_text: The great upheaval of good fortune wrought by fickle destiny — I am frightened like a son who has provoked his father's anger. (6.4)

body.translated_text: My heart is apprehensive about what [<s>Mahāsena</s>] will say — the maiden was taken away by me and I did not protect her.

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - na kiṃ sakkaṃ rakkhiduṃ pattakāḷe (BhSv_6.4:1)
[na kiṃ śakyaṃ rakṣituṃ prāptakāle | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Could she not have been protected when the time came?

body.text:
*{pratīhārī}* - eso kañcuīo dhattī a paḍihāraṃ uvaṭṭhidā (BhSv_6.4:2)
[eṣa kāñcukīyo dhātrī ca pratihāram upasthitau | ]
body.translated_text: *{Doorkeeper}* — Here are the chamberlain and the nurse, waiting at the entrance.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - śighraṃ praveśyatām (BhSv_6.4:3)
*{pratīhārī}* - jaṃ bhaṭṭā āṇavedi (BhSv_6.4:4)
[yad bhartājñāpayati | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Let them be shown in quickly. *{Doorkeeper}* — As the lord commands.
{She exits.} {Then enter the Chamberlain, the Nurse, and the Doorkeeper.} *{Chamberlain}* — Ah!

body.text: sambandhirājyam idam etya mahān praharṣaḥ smṛtvā punar nṛpasutānidhanaṃ viṣādaḥ &

children.text: kiṃ nāma daiva bhavatā na kṛtaṃ yadi syād rājyaṃ parair apahṛtaṃ kuśalaṃ ca devyāḥ // BhSv_6.5 //
children.translated_text: What indeed has fate not done? If the kingdom were seized by enemies and the queen were well — ! (6.5)

body.translated_text: Great is the joy at arriving at the kingdom of a kinsman; but again, sorrow upon recalling the death of the princess.

body.text:
*{pratīhārī}* - eso bhaṭṭā uvasappadu ayyo (BhSv_6.5:1)
[eṣa bhartā upasarpatv āryaḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Door-keeper (<s>pratīhārī</s>)}* — Here is the master. Let the noble sir approach.
[Here is the master. Let the noble sir approach.]

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* -
  {upetya (BhSv_6.5:2)}
jayatv āryaputraḥ (BhSv_6.5:3)
*{dhātrī}* - jedu bhaṭṭā (BhSv_6.5:4)
[jayatu bhartā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Chamberlain}* —
  {Approaching:}
Victory to the noble lord!
*{Nurse}* — Victory to the master!
[Victory to the master!]

body.text: pṛthivyāṃ rājavaṃśyānām udayāstamayaprabhuḥ &

children.text: api rājā sa kuśalī mayā kāṅkṣitabāndhavaḥ // BhSv_6.6 //
children.translated_text: is that king, whose kinship I have longed for, well? // BhSv_6.6 //

body.translated_text: He who commands the rise and fall of royal dynasties on earth —

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - atha kim (BhSv_6.6:1)
kuśalī mahāsenaḥ (BhSv_6.6:2)
ihāpi sarvagataṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchati (BhSv_6.6:3)
*{rājā}* -
  {āsanād utthāya (BhSv_6.6:4)}
kim ājñāpayati mahāsenaḥ (BhSv_6.6:5)
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - sadṛśam etad vaidehīputrasya (BhSv_6.6:6)
nanv āsanasthenaiva bhavatā śrotavyo mahāsenasya sandeśaḥ (BhSv_6.6:7)
*{rājā}* - yad ājñāpayati mahāsenaḥ (BhSv_6.6:8)
  {upaviśati (BhSv_6.6:9)}
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - diṣṭyā parair apahṛtaṃ rājyaṃ punaḥ pratyānītam iti (BhSv_6.6:10)
kutaḥ
body.translated_text:
*{Chamberlain}* — Indeed! <s>Mahāsena</s> [King <s>Pradyota</s>] is well. He also inquires about the general welfare here.
*{King}* —
  {Rising from his seat:}
What does <s>Mahāsena</s> command?
*{Chamberlain}* — This is worthy of the son of <s>Vaidehī</s>. But the message of <s>Mahāsena</s> should be heard by Your Lordship while seated.
*{King}* — As <s>Mahāsena</s> commands.
  {He sits down.}
*{Chamberlain}* — 'By good fortune, the kingdom that was seized by enemies has been recovered' — thus [he says]. How so —

body.text: kātarā ye 'py aśaktā vā notsāhas teṣu jāyate &

children.text: prāyeṇa hi narendraśrīḥ sotsāhair eva bhujyate // BhSv_6.7 //
children.translated_text: for royal fortune is generally enjoyed only by those who possess initiative. // BhSv_6.7 //

body.translated_text: Even in those who are timid or powerless, no enthusiasm arises;

body.text: *{rājā}* - ārya sarvam etan mahāsenasya prabhāvaḥ kutaḥ (BhSv_6.7:1)
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Noble sir, all of this is the glory of <s>Mahāsena</s>. How so —

body.text: aham avajitaḥ pūrvaṃ tāvat sutaiḥ saha lālito dṛḍham apahṛtā kanyā bhūyo mayā na ca rakṣitā &

children.text: nidhanam api ca śrutvā tasyās tathaiva mayi svatā nanu yad ucitān vatsān prāptuṃ nṛpo 'tra hi kāraṇam // BhSv_6.8 //
children.translated_text: Even upon hearing of her death, his affection toward me remained the same. Surely, [his] desire to gain the <s>Vatsas</s> [as worthy allies] — the king himself is the cause of this. // BhSv_6.8 //

body.translated_text: First I was defeated; then I was lovingly raised together with [his] children; his daughter was taken away — and I did not protect her.

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - eṣa mahāsenasya sandeśaḥ (BhSv_6.8:1)
devyāḥ sandeśam ihātrabhavatī kathayiṣyati (BhSv_6.8:2)
*{rājā}* - hā amba
body.translated_text:
*{Chamberlain}* — This is <s>Mahāsena</s>'s message. The queen's message — this lady here will convey.
*{King}* — Ah, Mother!

body.text: ṣoḍaśāntaḥpurajyeṣṭhā puṇyā nagaradevatā &

children.text: mama pravāsaduḥkhārtā mātā kuśalinī nanu // BhSv_6.9 //
children.translated_text: is my mother, afflicted by the sorrow of my exile, well? // BhSv_6.9 //

body.translated_text: The eldest of sixteen queens of the inner palace, auspicious, the presiding deity of the city —

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - aroā bhaṭṭiṇī bhaṭṭāraṃ savvagadaṃ kusaḷaṃ pucchadi (BhSv_6.9:1)
[arogā bhaṭṭinī bhartāraṃ sarvagataṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — The queen is in good health. She inquires about the general welfare of her son-in-law.
[The queen is in good health. She inquires about the general welfare of her son-in-law.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - sarvagataṃ kuśalam iti (BhSv_6.9:2)
amba īdṛśaṃ kuśalam (BhSv_6.9:3)
*{dhātrī}* - mā dāṇiṃ bhaṭṭā adimattaṃ santappiduṃ (BhSv_6.9:4)
[medānīṃ bhartātimātraṃ santaptum | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — 'General welfare,' she says. Mother, such is the welfare!
*{Nurse}* — Let the master not grieve beyond measure now.
[Let the master not grieve beyond measure now.]

body.text:
*{kāñcukīyaḥ}* - dhārayatv āryaputraḥ (BhSv_6.9:5)
uparatāpy anuparatā mahāsenaputrī evam anukampyamānāryaputreṇa (BhSv_6.9:6)
atha vā
body.translated_text: *{Chamberlain}* — Let the noble lord compose himself. Though the daughter of <s>Mahāsena</s> has passed away, she has not truly passed, since the noble lord shows her such compassion. Or rather —

body.text: kaḥ kaṃ śakto rakṣituṃ mṛtyukāle rajjucchede ke ghaṭaṃ dhārayanti &

children.text: evaṃ lokas tulyadharmo vanānāṃ kāle kāle chidyate ruhyate ca // BhSv_6.10 //
children.translated_text: Thus the world shares the same nature as forests — it is cut down and grows again, season after season. // BhSv_6.10 //

body.translated_text: Who can protect whom at the time of death? When the rope is cut, who can hold the pot?

body.text: *{rājā}* - ārya mā maivam (BhSv_6.10:1)
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Noble sir, do not say such things!

body.text: mahāsenasya duhitā śiṣyā devī ca me priyā &

children.text: kathaṃ sā na mayā śakyā smartuṃ dehāntareṣv api // BhSv_6.11 //
children.translated_text: how could I fail to remember her, even in future births? // BhSv_6.11 //

body.translated_text: The daughter of <s>Mahāsena</s>, my pupil, my queen, and my beloved —

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - āha bhaṭṭiṇī uvaradā vāsavadattā (BhSv_6.11:1)
mama vā mahāseṇassa vā jādisā govāḷaapāḷaā tādiso evva tumaṃ puḍhmaaṃ evva abhippedo jāmāduatti (BhSv_6.11:2)
edaṇṇimittaṃ ujjaiṇiṃ āṇīdo (BhSv_6.11:3)
aṇaggisakkhiaṃ vīṇāvavadeseṇa diṇṇā (BhSv_6.11:4)
attaṇo cavaḷadāe aṇi vuttavivāhamaṅgaḷo evva gado (BhSv_6.11:5)
ahaa ahmehiṃ tava a vāsavadattāe a paḍikidiṃ cittaphaḷaāe āḷihia vivāho ṇivvutto (BhSv_6.11:6)
esā cittaphaḷaā tava saāsaṃ pesidā (BhSv_6.11:7)
edaṃ pekkhia ṇivvudo hohi (BhSv_6.11:8)
[āha bhaṭṭinī uparatā vāsavadattā | mama vā mahāsenasya vā yādṛśau gopālakapālakau tādṛśa eva tvaṃ prathamam evābhipreto jāmāteti | etan nimittam ujjayinīm ānītaḥ | anagnisākṣikaṃ vīṇāvyapadeśena dattā | ātmanaś capalatayānirvṛttavivāhamaṅgala eva gataḥ | atha cāvābhyāṃ tava ca vāsavadattāyāś ca pratikṛtiṃ citraphalakāyām ālikhya vivāho nirvṛttaḥ | eṣā citraphalakā tava sakāśaṃ preṣitā | etāṃ dṛṣṭvā nirvṛto bhava | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — The queen says: '<s>Vāsavadattā</s> has passed away. Both I and <s>Mahāsena</s> — our beloved [child] — just as [we valued] the cowherd <s>Gopālaka</s> and the guardian <s>Pālaka</s>, so too you were our first choice as a son-in-law. For this purpose you were brought to <s>Ujjayinī</s>. Without the sacred fire as witness, [she was] given [to you] under the pretext of the <s>vīṇā</s> [lessons]. Through his own rashness, [you] departed without the wedding rites being completed. Then we had the wedding performed using a portrait of you and <s>Vāsavadattā</s> painted on a picture-board. This picture-board has been sent to you. Seeing it, be consoled.'
[The queen says: '<s>Vāsavadattā</s> has passed away. You were our first choice as son-in-law. You were brought to <s>Ujjayinī</s> for this purpose. She was given without the fire-witness under the pretext of the <s>vīṇā</s>. Through rashness you departed without wedding rites. We performed the wedding using a painted portrait. This picture-board is sent to you. Be consoled.']

body.text: *{rājā}* - aho atisnigdham anurūpaṃ cābhihitaṃ tatrabhavatyā (BhSv_6.11:9)
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Ah, what the noble lady has said is most affectionate and fitting!

body.text: vākyam etat priyataraṃ rājyalābhaśatād api &

children.text: aparāddheṣv api sneho yad asmāsu na vismṛtaḥ // BhSv_6.12 //
children.translated_text: that even toward us who have offended, their affection has not been forgotten. // BhSv_6.12 //

body.translated_text: These words are dearer than the gaining of a hundred kingdoms —

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyautta citragadaṃ guruaṇaṃ pekkhia abhivādeduṃ icchāmi (BhSv_6.12:1)
[āryaputra citragataṃ gurujanaṃ dṛṣṭvābhivādayitum icchāmi | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble lord, having seen the portrait of the elders, I wish to pay my respects.
[Noble lord, having seen the portrait of the elders, I wish to pay my respects.]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* -
  {dṛṣṭvā ātmagatam (BhSv_6.12:4)}
haṃ adisadisī khu iaṃ ayyāe āvantiāe (BhSv_6.12:5)
  {prakāśam} ayyautta sadisī khu iaṃ ayyāe (BhSv_6.12:6)
[ham atisadṛśī khalv iyam āryāyā āvantikāyāḥ | āryaputra sadṛśī khalv iyam āryāyāḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* —
  {Looking, aside:}
Hm! This looks remarkably like the noble <s>Āvantikā</s> [<s>Vāsavadattā</s> in her <s>Avantī</s> disguise]!
  {Aloud:} Noble lord, this indeed resembles the noble lady.
[Hm! This looks remarkably like the noble <s>Āvantikā</s>! Noble lord, this indeed resembles the noble lady.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - na sadṛśī (BhSv_6.12:7)
saiveti manye (BhSv_6.12:8)
bhoḥ kaṣṭam (BhSv_6.12:9)
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Not merely 'resembles' — I believe it is she herself. Alas, how terrible!

body.text: asya snigdhasya varṇasya vipattir dāruṇā katham &

children.text: idaṃ ca mukhamādhuryaṃ kathaṃ dūṣitam agninā // BhSv_6.13 //
children.translated_text: And how was this sweetness of her face ravaged by fire? // BhSv_6.13 //

body.translated_text: How could such cruel destruction befall this fair complexion?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyauttassa paḍikidiṃ pekkhia jāṇāmi iaṃ ayyāe sadisī ṇa vetti (BhSv_6.13:1)
[āryaputrasya pratikṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā jānāmīyam āryayā sadṛśī na veti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Having seen the noble lord's portrait, I shall know whether this [person] resembles the noble lady or not.
[Having seen the noble lord's portrait, I shall know whether she resembles the noble lady or not.]

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* - pekkhadu pekkhadu bhaṭṭidāriā (BhSv_6.13:2)
[paśyatu paśyatu bhartṛdārikā | ]
body.translated_text:
*{Nurse}* — Let the princess see, let her see!
[Let the princess see, let her see!]

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* -
  {dṛṣṭvā (BhSv_6.13:3)}
ayyauttassa paḍikidīe sadisadāe jāṇāmi iaṃ ayyāe sadisi tti (BhSv_6.13:4)
[āryaputrasya pratikṛtyāḥ sadṛśatayā jānāmīyam āryayā sadṛśīti | ]
body.translated_text:
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* —
  {Looking:}
From the resemblance to the noble lord's portrait, I know that this [person] does resemble the noble lady.
[From the resemblance to the noble lord's portrait, I know that she resembles the noble lady.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - devi citradarśanāt prabhṛti prahṛṣṭodvignām iva tvāṃ paśyāmi (BhSv_6.13:5)
kim idam (BhSv_6.13:6)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyautta imāe paḍikidīe sadisī iha evva paḍivasadi (BhSv_6.13:7)
[āryaputra asyāḥ pratikṛtyāḥ sadṛśīhaiva prativasati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Queen, since seeing the painting, you seem both delighted and agitated. What is this?
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Noble lord, one who resembles this portrait dwells right here.
[Noble lord, one who resembles this portrait dwells right here.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kiṃ vāsavadattāyāḥ (BhSv_6.13:8)
*{padmāvatī}* - āma (BhSv_6.13:9)
*{rājā}* - tena hi śīghram ānīyatām (BhSv_6.13:10)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayyautta mama kaṇṇābhāve keṇa vi bahmaṇeṇa mama bhaiṇiatti ṇṇāso ṇikkhitto (BhSv_6.13:11)
posidabhattuā parapurusadaṃsaṇaṃ pariharadi (BhSv_6.13:12)
tā ayyaṃ mae saha āadaṃ pekkhia jāṇādu ayyautto (BhSv_6.13:13)
[āryaputra mama kanyābhāve kenāpi brāhmaṇena mama bhaginiketi nyāso nikṣiptaḥ | proṣitabhartṛkā parapuruṣadarśanaṃ pariharati | tad āryāṃ mayā sahāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā jānātv āryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — What — [one who resembles] <s>Vāsavadattā</s>?
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — It must be so.
[It must be so.]

body.text: *{rājā}* -
body.translated_text: *{King}* —

body.text: yadi viprasya bhaginī vyaktam anyā bhaviṣyati &

children.text: parasparagatā loke dṛśyate rūpatulyatā // BhSv_6.14 //
children.translated_text: resemblance of appearance between unrelated people is seen in this world. // BhSv_6.14 //

body.translated_text: If she is the sister of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, she is clearly another [person];

body.text:
{praviśya (BhSv_6.14:1)}
*{pratīhārī}* - jedu bhaṭṭā (BhSv_6.14:2)
eso ujjaiṇīo bahmaṇo bhaṭṭiṇīe hatthe mama bhaiṇia tti ṇṇāso ṇikkhitto taṃ paḍiggahiduṃ paḍihāraṃ uvaṭṭhido (BhSv_6.14:3)
[jayatu bhartā | eṣa ujjayinīyo brāhmaṇaḥ bhaṭṭinyā haste mama bhaginiketi nyāso nikṣiptaḥ taṃ pratigrahītuṃ pratihāram upasthitaḥ | ]

*{rājā}* - padmāvati kin nu sa brāhmaṇaḥ (BhSv_6.14:4)
*{padmāvatī}* - hodavvaṃ (BhSv_6.14:5)
[bhavitavyam | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — <s>Padmāvatī</s>, could that be the [same] <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>?
*{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — It must be.
[It must be.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - śīghraṃ praveśyatām abhyantarasamudācāreṇa sa brāhmaṇaḥ (BhSv_6.14:6)
*{pratīhārī}* - jaṃ bhaṭṭā āṇavedi (BhSv_6.14:7)
  {niṣkrāntā (BhSv_6.14:8)}
[yad bhartājñāpayati | ]
body.translated_text:
*{King}* — Let that <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> be quickly admitted with full inner-court honors!
*{Door-keeper}* — As the master commands.
  {She exits.}
[As the master commands.]

body.text:
*{rājā}* - padmāvati tvam api tām ānaya (BhSv_6.14:9)
*{padmāvatī}* - jaṃ ayyautto āṇavedi (BhSv_6.14:10)
  {niṣkrāntā (BhSv_6.14:11)}
[yad āryaputra ājñāpayati | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — <s>Padmāvatī</s>, you too go and bring her. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — As the noble prince commands. {She exits.}
{Then <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s> and the doorkeeper enter.} *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Ah! {To himself:}

body.text: pracchādya rājamahiṣīṃ nṛpater hitārthaṃ kāmaṃ mayā kṛtam idaṃ hitam ity avekṣya &

children.text: siddhe 'pi nāma mama karmaṇi pārthivo 'sau kiṃ vakṣyatīti hṛdayaṃ pariśaṅkitaṃ me // BhSv_6.15 //
children.translated_text: yet even though my plan has succeeded, 'What will the king say?' — my heart is filled with apprehension. // <s>BhSv</s>_6.15 //

body.translated_text: Having concealed the chief queen for the king's welfare, this was indeed done by me, considering it beneficial;

body.text:
*{pratīhārī}* - eso bhaṭṭā (BhSv_6.15:1)
upasappadu ayyo (BhSv_6.15:2)
[eṣa bhartā | upasarpatv āryaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{Doorkeeper}* — Here is the master. Let the noble one approach.

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* -
  {upasṛtya (BhSv_6.15:3)}
jayatu bhavān jayatu (BhSv_6.15:4)
*{rājā}* - śrutapūrva iva svaraḥ (BhSv_6.15:5)
bho brāhmaṇa kiṃ bhavataḥ svasā padmāvatyā haste nyāsa iti nikṣiptā (BhSv_6.15:6)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - athakim (BhSv_6.15:7)
*{rājā}* - tena hi tvaryatāṃ tvaryatām asya bhaginikā (BhSv_6.15:8)
*{pratīhārī}* - jaṃ bhaṭṭā āṇavedi (BhSv_6.15:9)
  {niṣkrāntā}
[yad bhartājñāpayati | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — {Approaching.} Victory to your honor, victory! *{King}* — This voice sounds familiar. Sir <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, was your sister entrusted as a deposit in <s>Padmāvatī</s>'s care? *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Indeed so. *{King}* — Then make haste, make haste to [bring] his sister. *{Doorkeeper}* — As the master commands. {She exits.}

body.text:
{tataḥ praviśati padmāvatī āvantikā pratīhārī ca (BhSv_6.15:10)}
*{padmāvatī}* - edu edu ayyā (BhSv_6.15:11)
piaṃ de ṇivedemi (BhSv_6.15:12)
[etv etv āryā | priyaṃ te nivedayāmi | ]
body.translated_text: {Then <s>Padmāvatī</s>, <s>Āvantikā</s>, and the doorkeeper enter.} *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Come, come, my lady! I have joyful news to tell you.

body.text:
*{āvantikā}* - kiṃ kiṃ
[kiṃ kiṃ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Āvantikā</s>}* — What? What?

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* - bhādā de āado (BhSv_6.15:13)
[bhrātā te āgataḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Your brother has arrived!

body.text:
*{āvantikā}* - diṭṭhiā idāṇiṃ pi sumaradi (BhSv_6.15:14)
[diṣṭyedānīm api smarati | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Āvantikā</s>}* — Thank heavens, even now he remembers [me].

body.text:
*{padmāvatī}* -
  {upasṛtya (BhSv_6.15:15)}
jedu ayyautto (BhSv_6.15:16)
eso ṇāso (BhSv_6.15:17)
[jayatv āryaputraḥ | eṣa nyāsaḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — {Approaching.} Victory to the noble prince! Here is the deposit.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - niryātaya padmāvati sākṣiman nyāso niryātayitavyaḥ (BhSv_6.15:18)
ihātrabhavān raibhyaḥ atrabhavatī cādhikaraṇaṃ bhaviṣyataḥ (BhSv_6.15:19)
*{padmāvatī}* - ayya ṇīadāṃ dāṇiṃ ayyā (BhSv_6.15:20)
[ārya nīyatām idānīm āryā | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Return [her], <s>Padmāvatī</s>; a deposit must be returned before witnesses. Here the noble <s>Raibhya</s> and the noble lady shall serve as the court [of witness]. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Sir, let the lady be brought forth now.

body.text:
*{dhātrī}* -
  {āvantikāṃ nirvarṇya (BhSv_6.15:21)}
ammo bhaṭṭidāriā vāsavadattā (BhSv_6.15:22)
[ammo bhartṛdārikā vāsavadattā | ]
body.translated_text: *{Nurse}* — {Examining <s>Āvantikā</s> closely.} Oh! The princess <s>Vāsavadattā</s>!

body.text:
*{rājā}* - kathaṃ mahāsenaputrī (BhSv_6.15:23)
devi praviśa tvam abhyantaraṃ padmāvatyā saha (BhSv_6.15:24)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - na khalu na khalu praveṣṭavyam (BhSv_6.15:25)
mama bhaginī khalv eṣā (BhSv_6.15:26)
*{rājā}* - kiṃ bhavān āha (BhSv_6.15:27)
mahāsenaputrī khalv eṣā (BhSv_6.15:28)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - bho rājan
body.translated_text: *{King}* — What? The daughter of <s>Mahāsena</s>? O queen, enter the inner chambers with <s>Padmāvatī</s>. *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — No, no! She must not enter. This is indeed my sister. *{King}* — What does your honor say? This is the daughter of <s>Mahāsena</s>! *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — O King!

body.text: bhāratānāṃ kule jāto vinīto jñānavāñ chuciḥ &

children.text: tannāīsi balād dhartuṃ rājadharmasya deśikaḥ // BhSv_6.16 //
children.translated_text: you should not forcibly seize her; [I am] the guide of royal duty. // <s>BhSv</s>_6.16 //

body.translated_text: Born in the family of the <s>Bhāratas</s>, disciplined, wise, and pure —

body.text:
*{rājā}* - bhavatu paśyāmas tāvad rūpasādṛśyam (BhSv_6.16:1)
saṃkṣipyatāṃ yavanikā (BhSv_6.16:2)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - jayatu svāmī (BhSv_6.16:3)
*{vāsavadattā}* - jedu ayyautto (BhSv_6.16:4)
[jayatv āryaputraḥ | ]
body.translated_text: *{King}* — Very well. Let us first see if there is a resemblance. Let the curtain be drawn aside! *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — Victory to the lord! *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — Victory to the noble prince!

children.text: *{rājā}* - aye asau yaugandharāyaṇaḥ iyaṃ mahāsenaputrī (BhSv_6.16:5)
children.translated_text: *{King}* — Ah! That is <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>! And this is the daughter of <s>Mahāsena</s>!

children.text: kin nu satyam idaṃ svapnaḥ sā bhūyo dṛśyate mayā &
children.translated_text: Is this true, or a dream? She is seen by me once again!

children.text: anayāpy evam evāhaṃ dṛṣṭayā vañcitas tadā // BhSv_6.17 //
children.translated_text: By her too, in just the same way, I was deceived then. // <s>BhSv</s>_6.17 //

body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — My lord, I have committed an offense by removing the queen. May the lord be pleased to forgive. {He falls at his feet.} *{King}* — {Raising him.} You are <s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>, are you not?

body.text: mithyonmādaiś ca yuddhaiś ca śāstradṛṣṭaiś ca mantritaiḥ &

children.text: bhavadyatnaiḥ khalu vayaṃ majjamānāḥ samuddhṛtāḥ // BhSv_6.18 //
children.translated_text: through your efforts indeed, we who were sinking have been rescued! // <s>BhSv</s>_6.18 //

body.translated_text: Through feigned madness, through battles, through stratagems prescribed by the <s>śāstras</s>,

body.text:
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - svāmibhāgyānām anugantāro vayam (BhSv_6.18:1)
*{padmāvatī}* - ammahe ayyā khu iaṃ (BhSv_6.18:2)
ayye sahījaṇasamudāāreṇa ajāṇantīe adikkando samudāāro (BhSv_6.18:3)
tā sīseṇa pasādemi (BhSv_6.18:4)
[aho āryā khalv iyam | ārye sakhījanasamudācāreṇājānatyātikrāntaḥ samudācāraḥ tac chīrṣeṇa prasādayāmi | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Yaugandharāyaṇa</s>}* — We are but followers of the lord's good fortune. *{<s>Padmāvatī</s>}* — Oh! So this is my lady [<s>Vāsavadattā</s>]! My lady, through the courtesy of a friend — unknowingly I have transgressed proper conduct. Therefore I bow my head to make amends.

body.text:
*{vāsavadattā}* -
  {padmāvatīm utthāpya (BhSv_6.18:5)}
uṭṭhehi uṭṭhehi avihave uṭṭhehi (BhSv_6.18:6)
atthisaaṃ ṇāma sarīraṃ avaraddhai (BhSv_6.18:7)
[uttiṣṭhottiṣṭhāvidhave uttiṣṭha | arthisvaṃ nāma śarīram aparādhyati | ]
body.translated_text: *{<s>Vāsavadattā</s>}* — {Raising <s>Padmāvatī</s>.} Rise, rise, O fortunate one, rise! A body that has an [important] purpose [to serve] commits no offense.

body.text:
*{rājā}* - vayasya yaugandharāyaṇa devyapanaye kā kṛtā te buddhiḥ (BhSv_6.18:8)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - kauśāmbīmātraṃ paripālayāmīti (BhSv_6.18:9)
*{rājā}* - atha padmāvatyā haste kiṃ nyāsakāraṇam (BhSv_6.18:10)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - puṣpakabhadrādibhir ādeśikair ādiṣṭā svāmino devī bhaviṣyatīti (BhSv_6.18:11)
*{rājā}* - idam api rumaṇvatā jñātam (BhSv_6.18:12)
*{yaugandharāyaṇaḥ}* - svāmin sarvair eva jñātam (BhSv_6.18:13)
